tgl: At naglihi si Lea, at nanganak ng isang lalake, at tinawag niya ang kaniyang pangalan na Ruben; sapagka't kaniyang sinabi, Sapagka't nilingap ng Panginoon ang aking kapighatian; dahil sa ngayo'y mamahalin ako ng aking asawa.
en: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me. <sup>Reuben: that is, See a son</sup>

tgl: At naglihi uli, at nanganak ng isang lalake; at nagsabi, Sapagka't narinig ng Panginoon na ako'y kinapopootan ay ibinigay rin naman sa akin ito: at pinanganlan niyang Simeon.
en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon. <sup>Simeon: that is, Hearing</sup>

tgl: At naglihi uli at nanganak ng isang lalake; at nagsabi, Ngayo'y masasama na sa akin ang aking asawa, sapagka't nagkaanak ako sa kaniya ng tatlong lalake: kaya't pinanganlan niyang Levi.
en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi. <sup>Levi: that is, Joined</sup>

tgl: At muling naglihi at nanganak ng isang lalake, at nagsabi, Ngayo'y aking pupurihin ang Panginoon: kaya't pinanganlang Juda; at hindi na nanganak.
en: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing. <sup>Judah: that is, Praise</sup> <sup>left: Heb. stood from bearing</sup>

tgl: At nang makita ni Raquel, na hindi siya nagkakaanak kay Jacob, ay nainggit si Raquel sa kaniyang kapatid; at sinabi kay Jacob, Bigyan mo ako ng anak, o kung hindi ay mamamatay ako!
en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

tgl: At nagningas ang galit ni Jacob laban kay Raquel; at nagsabi, Ako ba'y nasa kalagayan ng Dios, na nagkait sa iyo ng bunga ng bahay-bata?
en: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

tgl: At sinabi niya, Narito ang aking alilang si Bilha, sumiping ka sa kaniya; upang manganak sa ibabaw ng aking mga tuhod, at magkaroon din naman ako ng anak sa pamamagitan niya.
en: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her. <sup>have: Heb. be built by her</sup>

tgl: At ibinigay niyang asawa si Bilha na kaniyang alila: at sinipingan ni Jacob.
en: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

tgl: At naglihi si Bilha, at nagkaanak kay Jacob, ng isang lalake.
en: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

tgl: At sinabi ni Raquel, Hinatulan ako ng Dios, at dininig din naman ang aking tinig, at binigyan ako ng anak: kaya't pinanganlang Dan.
en: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan. <sup>Dan: that is, Judging</sup>

tgl: At si Bilhang alila ni Raquel ay naglihi uli at ipinanganak ang kaniyang ikalawang anak kay Jacob.
en: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

tgl: At sinabi ni Raquel, Ako'y nakipagbaka ng malaking pakikipagbaka sa aking kapatid, at ako'y nanaig: at siya'y pinanganlang Nephtali.
en: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali. <sup>great: Heb. wrestlings of God</sup> <sup>Naphtali: that is, My wrestling: Gr. Nephthalim</sup>

tgl: Nang makita ni Lea, na siya'y hindi na nanganganak, ay kinuha si Zilpa na kaniyang alila at ibinigay na asawa kay Jacob.
en: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

tgl: At si Zilpa na alila ni Lea ay nagkaanak ng isang lalake kay Jacob.
en: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.

tgl: At sinabi ni Lea, Kapalaran! at pinanganlang Gad.
en: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad. <sup>Gad: that is, A troop, or, company</sup>

tgl: At ipinanganak ni Zilpa na alila ni Lea, ang kaniyang ikalawang anak kay Jacob.
en: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.

tgl: At sinabi ni Lea, Mapalad ako! sapagka't tatawagin akong mapalad ng mga babae: at tinawag niya ang kaniyang pangalan na Aser.
en: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher. <sup>Happy: Heb. In my happiness</sup> <sup>Asher: that is, Happy</sup>

tgl: At yumaon si Ruben nang panahon ng paggapas ng trigo, at nakasumpong ng mga mandragoras sa bukid, at dinala sa kaniyang inang kay Lea. Nang magkagayo'y sinabi ni Raquel kay Lea, Ipinamamanhik ko sa iyo na bigyan mo ako ng mga mandragoras ng iyong anak.
en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.

tgl: At kaniyang sinabi, Kakaunti pa bang bagay na iyong kinuha ang aking asawa? at ibig mo pa ring kunin ang mga mandragoras ng aking anak? At sinabi ni Raquel, Kaya't sisiping siya sa iyo ngayong gabi, dahil sa mga mandragoras ng iyong anak.
en: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.

tgl: At si Jacob ay umuwing galing sa bukid ng hapon, at sinalubong siya ni Lea, at sa kaniya'y sinabi, Sa akin ka dapat sumiping; sapagka't tunay na ikaw ay aking inupahan ng mga mandragoras ng aking anak. At sumiping siya sa kaniya ng gabing yaon.
en: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

tgl: At dininig ng Dios si Lea: at siya'y naglihi at kaniyang ipinanganak kay Jacob ang kaniyang ikalimang anak.
en: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

tgl: At sinabi ni Lea, Ibinigay sa akin ng Dios ang aking kaupahan, sapagka't ibinigay ko ang aking alila sa aking asawa: at kaniyang pinanganlang Issachar.
en: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar. <sup>Issachar: that is, An hire</sup>

tgl: At naglihi uli si Lea, at kaniyang ipinanganak ang kaniyang ikaanim na anak kay Jacob.
en: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

tgl: At sinabi ni Lea, Binigyan ako ng Dios ng isang mabuting kaloob; ngayo'y makikisama na sa akin ang aking asawa, sapagka't nagkaanak ako sa kaniya ng anim na lalake: at kaniyang pinanganlang Zabulon.
en: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun. <sup>Zebulun: that is, Dwelling: Gr. Zabulon</sup>

tgl: At pagkatapos ay nanganak siya ng babae, at kaniyang pinanganlang Dina.
en: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah. <sup>Dinah: that is Judgment</sup>

tgl: At naalala ng Dios si Raquel, at dininig ng Dios, at binuksan ang kaniyang bahay-bata.
en: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

tgl: At siya'y naglihi at nanganak ng lalake; at kaniyang sinabi, Inalis ng Dios sa akin ang kakutyaan ko:
en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

tgl: At kaniyang tinawag ang pangalan niya na Jose, na sinasabi, Dagdagan pa ako ng Panginoon ng isang anak.
en: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son. <sup>Joseph: that is, Adding</sup>

tgl: At nangyari, nang maipanganak ni Raquel si Jose, na sinabi ni Jacob kay Laban, Papagpaalamin mo ako upang ako'y makaparoon sa aking dakong tinubuan at sa aking lupain.
en: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

tgl: Ibigay mo sa akin ang aking mga asawa at ang aking mga anak, na siyang kadahilanan ng ipinaglingkod ko sa iyo, at papagpaalamin mo ako: sapagka't talastas mo ang paglilingkod na ipinaglingkod ko sa iyo.
en: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

tgl: At sinabi sa kaniya ni Laban, Kung ako'y nakasumpong ng biyaya sa harap ng iyong mga mata, matira ka: aking napagkilala, na pinagpala ako ng Panginoon dahil sa iyo.
en: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.

tgl: At kaniyang sinabi, Sabihin mo sa akin ang iyong kaupahan, at ibibigay ko sa iyo.
en: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kaniya, Nalalaman mo kung paanong pinaglingkuran kita, at kung anong lagay ng iyong mga hayop dahil sa akin.
en: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

tgl: Sapagka't kakaunti ang tinatangkilik mo bago ako dumating, at naging isang karamihan; at pinagpala ka ng Panginoon saan man ako pumihit; at ngayo'y kailan naman ako maghahanda ng sa aking sariling bahay?
en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also? <sup>increased: Heb. broken forth</sup> <sup>since: Heb. at my foot</sup>

tgl: At sa kaniya'y sinabi, Anong ibibigay ko sa iyo? At sinabi ni Jacob, Huwag mo akong bigyan ng anoman: kung ito'y iyong gawin sa akin, ay muli kong papastulin at aalagaan ang iyong kawan.
en: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:

tgl: Dadaanan ko ang lahat mong kawan ngayon, na aking ihihiwalay doon ang lahat ng batikbatik at may dungis, at ang lahat na maitim sa mga tupa, at ang may dungis at batikbatik sa mga kambing: at siyang magiging aking kaupahan.
en: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

tgl: Gayon ako sasagutan ng aking katuwiran sa haharapin, pagparito mo, tungkol sa aking kaupahan, na nasa harap mo; yaong lahat na walang batik at walang dungis sa mga kambing, at hindi maitim sa mga tupa, na masusumpungan sa akin, ay maibibilang mong nakaw.
en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me. <sup>in time: Heb. to morrow</sup>

tgl: At sinabi ni Laban, Narito, mangyari nawa ayon sa iyong sabi.
en: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

tgl: At inihiwalay ni Laban ng araw ding yaon ang mga lalaking kambing na may batik at may dungis, at ang lahat ng babaing kambing na may batik at may dungis, lahat ng mayroong kaunting puti, at lahat ng maitim sa mga tupa, at ibinigay sa mga kamay ng kaniyang mga anak;
en: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

tgl: At siya'y naglakad ng tatlong araw ang pagitan kay Jacob; at pinakain ni Jacob ang nalabi sa mga kawan ni Laban.
en: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.

tgl: At kumuha si Jacob ng mga sanga ng alamo, at almendro at kastano; at pinagbabakbakan ng mga batik na mapuputi, at kaniyang pinalitaw na gayon ang puti na nasa mga sanga.
en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

tgl: At kaniyang inilagay ang mga sangang kaniyang binakbakan sa mga bangbang, sa harap ng kawan, sa mga pinagpapainuman; na pinaparoonan ng mga kawan upang uminom; at nangaglilihi pagka nagsisiparoon upang uminom.
en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

tgl: At nangaglilihi ang mga kawan sa harap ng mga sanga at nanganganak ang mga kawan ng mga may guhit, may batik at may dungis.
en: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

tgl: At ang mga korderong ito ay inihihiwalay ni Jacob, at inihaharap ang kawan sa dakong may batik, at ang lahat ng maitim sa kawan ni Laban; sa kaniyang ibinukod ang mga kawan niya rin, at hindi isinama sa kawan ni Laban.
en: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.

tgl: At nangyari, na kailan ma't maglilihi ang mga malakas sa kawan, ay inilalagay ni Jacob ang mga sanga sa harap ng mga mata ng kawan sa mga bangbang, upang sila'y papaglihihin sa gitna ng mga sanga.
en: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

tgl: Datapuwa't pagka ang kawan ay mahina ay hindi niya inilalagay, kaya't ang mahina ay nagiging kay Laban at ang malakas ay kay Jacob.
en: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.

tgl: At ang lalake ay lumagong mainam; at nagkaroon ng malalaking kawan, at ng mga aliping babae at lalake, at ng mga kamelyo at ng mga asno.
en: And the man increased exceedingly , and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

tgl: At narinig ni Jacob ang mga salita ng mga anak ni Laban, na nagsisipagsabi, Kinuha ni Jacob ang lahat ng sa ating ama; at doon sa mga sa ating ama ay tinamo niya ang buong karangalang ito.
en: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.

tgl: At minasdan ni Jacob ang mukha ni Laban, at narito't hindi sumasa kaniyang gaya ng dati.
en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before. <sup>as before: Heb. as yesterday and the day before</sup>

tgl: At sinabi ng Panginoon kay Jacob, Magbalik ka sa lupain ng iyong mga magulang, at sa iyong kamaganakan; at ako'y sasaiyo.
en: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

tgl: At si Jacob ay nagsugo at tinawag si Raquel at si Lea sa bukid, sa kaniyang kawan,
en: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

tgl: At sinabi sa kanila, Nakikita ko ang mukha ng inyong ama, na hindi sumasaakin na gaya ng dati; datapuwa't ang Dios ng aking ama ay sumaakin.
en: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

tgl: At nalalaman ninyo, na ang aking buong lakas ay ipinaglingkod ko sa inyong ama.
en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

tgl: At dinaya ako ng inyong ama, at binagong makasangpu ang aking kaupahan; datapuwa't hindi pinahintulutan siya ng Dios, na gawan ako ng masama.
en: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

tgl: Kung kaniyang sinabing ganito, Ang mga may batik ang magiging kaupahan mo; kung magkagayo'y nanganganak ang lahat ng kawan ng mga may batik: at kung kaniyang sinabing ganito, Ang mga may guhit ang magiging kaupahan mo; kung magkagayo'y ang lahat ng kawan ay manganganak ng mga may guhit.
en: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.

tgl: Ganito inalis ng Dios ang mga hayop ng inyong ama, at ibinigay sa akin.
en: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

tgl: At nangyari, na sa panahong ang kawan ay naglilihi, ay itiningin ko ang aking mga mata, at nakita ko sa panaginip, at narito, ang mga kambing na lalake na nakatakip sa kawan ay mga may guhit, may batik at may dungis.
en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled. <sup>rams: or, he goats</sup>

tgl: At sinabi sa akin ng anghel ng Dios, sa panaginip, Jacob: at sinabi ko, Narito ako.
en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.

tgl: At kaniyang sinabi, Itingin mo ngayon ang iyong mga mata, tingnan mo na ang lahat ng kambing na natatakip sa kawan ay may guhit, may batik at may dungis: sapagka't aking nakita ang lahat na ginagawa sa iyo ni Laban.
en: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

tgl: Ako ang Dios ng Betel, na doon mo pinahiran ng langis ang batong pinakaalaala, at doon ka gumawa ng panata sa akin: ngayo'y tumindig ka, umalis ka sa lupaing ito, at bumalik ka sa lupaing pinanganakan sa iyo.
en: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

tgl: At nagsisagot si Raquel at si Lea, at sa kaniya'y sinabi, Mayroon pa ba kaming natitirang bahagi o mana sa bahay ng aming ama?
en: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

tgl: Hindi ba inaari niya kaming taga ibang bayan? sapagka't ipinagbili niya kami at kaniyang lubos nang kinain ang aming halaga.
en: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

tgl: Sapagka't ang buong kayamanang inalis ng Dios sa aming ama, ay amin yaon at sa aming mga anak: ngayon nga, gawin mo ang lahat ng sinabi sa iyo ng Dios.
en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.

tgl: Nang magkagayo'y tumindig si Jacob, at pinasakay sa mga kamello ang kaniyang mga anak at ang kaniyang mga asawa;
en: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

tgl: At dinala ang kaniyang lahat na hayop, at ang kaniyang buong pag-aaring tinipon, ang hayop na kaniyang napakinabang, na kaniyang tinipon, sa Padan-aram, upang pumaroon kay Isaac na kaniyang ama, sa lupain ng Canaan.
en: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

tgl: Si Laban nga ay yumaon upang gupitan ang kaniyang mga tupa: at ninakaw ni Raquel ang mga larawang tinatangkilik ng kaniyang ama.
en: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's. <sup>images: Heb. teraphim</sup>

tgl: At tumanan si Jacob na di nalalaman ni Laban na taga Siria, sa di niya pagbibigay alam na siya'y tumakas.
en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled. <sup>unawares: Heb. the heart of Laban</sup>

tgl: Ganito tumakas si Jacob sangpu ng buong kaniya; at bumangon at tumawid sa ilog Eufrates, at siya'y tumungo sa bundok ng Gilead.
en: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.

tgl: At binalitaan si Laban sa ikatlong araw, na tumakas si Jacob.
en: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

tgl: At ipinagsama niya ang kaniyang mga kapatid, at hinabol niyang pitong araw; at kaniyang inabutan sa bundok ng Gilead.
en: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

tgl: At naparoon ang Dios kay Laban na taga Siria, sa panaginip sa gabi, at sa kaniya'y sinabi, Ingatan mong huwag kang magsalita kay Jacob ng mabuti o masama man,
en: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad. <sup>either: Heb. from good to bad</sup>

tgl: At inabutan ni Laban si Jacob, At naitirik na ni Jacob ang kaniyang tolda sa bundok; at si Laban sangpu ng kaniyang mga kapatid ay nagtirik din sa bundok ng Gilead.
en: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

tgl: At sinabi ni Laban kay Jacob, Anong ginawa mo na tumanan ka ng di ko nalalaman, at dinala mo ang aking mga anak na parang mangabihag sa tabak?
en: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

tgl: Bakit ka tumakas ng lihim, at tumanan ka sa akin; at hindi mo ipinaalam sa akin, upang ikaw ay napagpaalam kong may sayahan at may awitan, may tambol at may alpa;
en: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp? <sup>steal: Heb. hast stolen me</sup>

tgl: At hindi mo man lamang ipinahintulot sa aking humalik sa aking mga anak na lalake at babae? Ngayon nga'y gumawa ka ng kamangmangan.
en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

tgl: Nasa kapangyarihan ng aking kamay ang gawan ko kayo ng masama: nguni't ang Dios ng inyong ama ay kinausap ako kagabi, na sinasabi, Ingatan mong huwag kang magsalita kay Jacob ng mabuti o masama man.
en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

tgl: At ngayon, bagaman iyong inibig yumaon, sapagka't pinagmimithian mong datnin ang bahay ng iyong ama ay bakit mo ninakaw ang aking mga dios?
en: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

tgl: At sumagot si Jacob, at sinabi kay Laban, Sapagka't ako'y natakot: sapagka't sinabi kong baka mo alising sapilitan sa akin ang iyong mga anak.
en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

tgl: Kaya kung kanino mo masumpungan ang iyong mga dios, ay huwag mabuhay: sa harap ng ating mga kapatid ay iyong kilalanin kung anong mayroon akong iyo, at dalhin mo sa iyo. Sapagka't hindi nalalaman ni Jacob na si Raquel ang nagnakaw.
en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

tgl: At pumasok si Laban sa tolda ni Jacob, at sa tolda ni Lea, at sa tolda ng dalawang alilang babae, datapuwa't hindi niya nasumpungan; at lumabas sa tolda ni Lea, at pumasok sa tolda ni Raquel.
en: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

tgl: Nakuha nga ni Raquel ang mga larawan, at naisiksik sa mga daladalahan ng kamello at kaniyang inupuan. At inapuhap ni Laban ang buong palibot ng tolda, nguni't hindi niya nasumpungan.
en: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not. <sup>searched: Heb. felt</sup>

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kaniyang ama, Huwag magalit ang aking panginoon na ako'y hindi makatindig sa harap mo; sapagka't ako'y mayroon ng kaugalian ng mga babae. At kaniyang hinanap, datapuwa't hindi masumpungan ang mga larawan.
en: And she said to her father, Let it not displease  my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.

tgl: At naginit si Jacob at nakipagtalo kay Laban, at sumagot si Jacob, at sinabi kay Laban, Ano ang aking sinalangsang at ang aking kasalanan, upang ako'y habulin mong may pagiinit?
en: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

tgl: Yamang inapuhap mo ang lahat ng aking kasangkapan, anong nasumpungan mong kasangkapan, ng iyong bahay? Ilagay mo rito sa harap ng aking mga kapatid at ng iyong mga kapatid, upang hatulan nila tayong dalawa.
en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both. <sup>searched: Heb. felt</sup>

tgl: Ako'y natira sa iyo nitong dalawang pung taon: ang iyong mga babaing tupa, at ang iyong mga babaing kambing ay hindi nawalan ng kanilang mga anak, at ang mga tupang lalake ng iyong kawan ay hindi ko kinain.
en: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

tgl: Ang nilapa ng mga ganid ay hindi ko dinala sa iyo; ako ang nagbata ng kawalan; sa aking kamay mo hiningi, maging nanakaw sa araw, o nanakaw sa gabi.
en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

tgl: Ganito nakaraan ako; sa araw ay pinupugnaw ako ng init, at ng lamig sa gabi; at ang pagaantok ay tumatakas sa aking mga mata.
en: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.

tgl: Nitong dalawang pung taon ay natira ako sa iyong bahay; pinaglingkuran kitang labing apat na taon dahil sa iyong dalawang anak, at anim na taon dahil sa iyong kawan: at binago mo ang aking kaupahan na makasangpu.
en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen  years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

tgl: Kung hindi sumaakin ang Dios ng aking ama, ang Dios ni Abraham, at ang Katakutan ni Isaac, ay walang pagsalang palalayasin mo ako ngayong walang dala. Nakita ng Dios ang aking kapighatian, ang kapaguran ng aking mga kamay, at sinaway ka niya kagabi.
en: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

tgl: At sumagot si Laban at sinabi kay Jacob, Ang mga anak na babaing ito, ay aking mga anak at itong mga anak ay mga anak ko, at ang mga kawan ay mga kawan ko, at ang lahat ng iyong nakikita ay akin: at anong magagawa ko ngayon sa mga anak kong babae, o sa kanilang mga anak na ipinanganak nila?
en: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?

tgl: At ngayo'y halika, gumawa tayo ng isang tipan, ako't ikaw na maging patotoo sa akin at sa iyo.
en: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

tgl: At kumuha si Jacob ng isang bato, at itinindig na pinakaalaala.
en: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

tgl: At sinabi ni Jacob sa kaniyang mga kapatid, Manguha kayo ng mga bato; at kumuha sila ng mga bato at kanilang ginawang isang bunton: at sila'y nagkainan doon sa malapit sa bunton.
en: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

tgl: At pinanganlan ni Laban na Jegarsahadutha, datapuwa't pinanganlan ni Jacob na Galaad.
en: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed. <sup>Jegarsahadutha: that is, The heap of witness, Chaldee</sup> <sup>Galeed: that is, The heap of witness, Heb.</sup>

tgl: At sinabi ni Laban, Ang buntong ito ay saksi sa akin at sa iyo ngayon. Kaya't ang pangalan niya'y tinawag na Galaad;
en: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

tgl: At Mizpa sapagka't kaniyang sinabi, Bantayan ng Panginoon ako at ikaw, pag nagkakahiwalay tayo.
en: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another. <sup>Mizpah: that is, A beacon, or, watchtower</sup>

tgl: Kung pahirapan mo ang aking mga anak, o kung magasawa ka sa iba bukod sa aking mga anak, ay wala tayong ibang kasama; tingnan mo, ang Dios ay saksi sa akin at sa iyo.
en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

tgl: At sinabi ni Laban kay Jacob, Narito, ang buntong ito at ang batong pinakaalaalang ito, na aking inilagay sa gitna natin.
en: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;

tgl: Maging saksi ang buntong ito, at saksi ang batong ito, na hindi ko lalagpasan ang buntong ito sa dako mo, at hindi mo lalagpasan ang buntong ito at ang batong pinakaalaalang ito sa pagpapahamak sa amin.
en: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

tgl: Ang Dios ni Abraham at ang Dios ni Nachor, ang Dios ng ama nila ay siyang humatol sa atin. At si Jacob ay sumumpa ng ayon sa Katakutan ng kaniyang amang si Isaac.
en: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

tgl: At naghandog si Jacob ng hain sa bundok, at tinawag ang kaniyang mga kapatid upang magsikain ng tinapay: at sila'y nagsikain ng tinapay, at sila'y nagparaan ng buong gabi sa bundok.
en: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount. <sup>offered: or, killed beasts</sup>

tgl: At bumangong maaga sa kinaumagahan si Laban, at hinagkan ang kaniyang mga anak na lalake at babae, at pinagbabasbasan: at yumaon at umuwi si Laban.
en: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

tgl: At ipinagpatuloy ni Jacob ang kaniyang paglakad, at sinalubong siya ng mga anghel ng Dios.
en: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

tgl: At sinabi ni Jacob nang makita niya sila, Ito'y hukbo ng Dios: at tinawag niya ang pangalan ng dakong yaon na Mahanaim.
en: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim. <sup>Mahanaim: that is, Two hosts, or, camps</sup>

tgl: At si Jacob ay nagpasugo sa unahan niya kay Esau, na kaniyang kapatid sa lupain ng Seir, na parang ng Edom.
en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom. <sup>country: Heb. field</sup>

tgl: At inutusan niya sila, na sinasabi, Ganito ninyo sabihin sa aking panginoong kay Esau, Ganito ang sabi ng iyong lingkod na si Jacob, Dumoon ako kay Laban at ako'y natira roon hanggang ngayon.
en: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

tgl: At mayroon akong mga baka, at mga asno, at mga kawan, at mga aliping lalake at babae: at ako'y nagpasugo upang magbigay alam sa aking panginoon, upang makasumpong ng biyaya sa iyong paningin.
en: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

tgl: At ang mga sugo ay nagsipagbalik kay Jacob, na nagsipagsabi, Dumating kami sa iyong kapatid na kay Esau, at siya rin naman ay sumasalubong sa iyo, at apat na raang tao ang kasama niya.
en: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

tgl: Nang magkagayo'y natakot na mainam si Jacob at nahapis at kaniyang binahagi ang bayang kasama niya, at ang mga kawan, at ang mga bakahan, at ang mga kamelyo ng dalawang pulutong.
en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

tgl: At kaniyang sinabi, Kung dumating si Esau sa isang pulutong, at kaniyang saktan, ang pulutong ngang natitira ay tatanan.
en: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

tgl: At sinabi ni Jacob, Oh Dios ng aking amang si Abraham, at Dios ng aking amang si Isaac, Oh Panginoon, na nagsabi sa akin, Magbalik ka sa iyong lupain at sa iyong kamaganakan, at gagawan kita ng magaling:
en: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

tgl: Hindi ako marapat sa kababababaan ng lahat ng kaawaan, at ng buong katotohanan na iyong ipinakita sa iyong lingkod: sapagka't dala ko ang aking tungkod, na dinaanan ko ang Jordang ito; at ngayo'y naging dalawang pulutong ako.
en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands. <sup>I am not: Heb. I am less than all</sup>

tgl: Iligtas mo ako, ipinamamanhik ko sa iyo, sa kamay ng aking kapatid, sa kamay ni Esau; sapagka't ako'y natatakot sa kaniya, baka siya'y dumating at ako'y saktan niya, ang ina pati ng mga anak.
en: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children. <sup>with: Heb. upon</sup>

tgl: At ikaw ang nagsabi, Tunay na ikaw ay gagawan ko ng magaling, at gagawin ko ang iyong binhi na parang buhangin sa dagat, na hindi mabibilang dahil sa karamihan.
en: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

tgl: At siya'y nagparaan doon ng gabing yaon; at kumuha ng mayroon siya na ipagkakaloob kay Esau na kaniyang kapatid;
en: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

tgl: Dalawang daang kambing na babae, at dalawang pung lalaking kambing; dalawang daang tupang babae, at dalawang pung tupang lalake,
en: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

tgl: Tatlong pung kamelyong inahin na pati ng kanilang mga anak; apat na pung baka at sangpung toro, dalawang pung asna at sangpung anak ng mga yaon.
en: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

tgl: At ipinagbibigay sa kamay ng kaniyang mga bataan, bawa't kawan ay bukod; at sinabi sa kaniyang mga bataan, Lumagpas kayo sa unahan ko, at iiwanan ninyo ng isang pagitan ang bawa't kawan.
en: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

tgl: At iniutos sa una, na sinasabi, Pagka ikaw ay nasumpungan ni Esau na aking kapatid, at ikaw ay tinanong na sinasabi, Kanino ka? at saan ka paroroon? at kanino itong nangasa unahan mo.
en: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

tgl: Kung magkagayo'y sasabihin mo, Sa iyong lingkod na kay Jacob; isang kaloob nga, na padala sa aking panginoong kay Esau: at, narito, siya'y nasa hulihan din naman namin.
en: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

tgl: At iniutos din sa ikalawa, at sa ikatlo, at sa lahat ng sumusunod sa mga kawan, na sinasabi, Sa ganitong paraan sasalitain ninyo kay Esau, pagkasumpong ninyo sa kaniya;
en: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed  the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.

tgl: At sasabihin ninyo, Saka, narito, ang iyong lingkod na si Jacob, ay nasa hulihan namin, sapagka't kaniyang sinabi, Paglulubagin ko ang kaniyang galit sa pamamagitan ng kaloob na sumasaunahan ko, at pagkatapos ay makikita ko ang kaniyang mukha; marahil ay tatanggapin niya ako.
en: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me. <sup>of me: Heb. my face</sup>

tgl: Gayon isinaunahan niya ang mga kaloob; at siya'y natira ng gabing yaon sa pulutong.
en: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

tgl: At siya'y bumangon ng gabing yaon, at isinama niya ang kaniyang dalawang asawa, at ang kaniyang dalawang alilang babae, at ang kaniyang labing isang anak at tumawid sa tawiran ng Jaboc.
en: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven  sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

tgl: At sila'y kaniyang isinama at itinawid sa batis, at kaniyang itinawid ang kaniyang tinatangkilik.
en: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had. <sup>sent them: Heb. caused to pass</sup>

tgl: At naiwang magisa si Jacob: at nakipagbuno ang isang lalake sa kaniya, hanggang sa magbukang liwayway.
en: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day. <sup>breaking: Heb. ascending of the morning</sup>

tgl: At nang makita nitong siya'y hindi manaig sa kaniya ay hinipo ang kasukasuan ng hita niya; at ang kasukasuan ni Jacob ay sinaktan samantalang nakikipagbuno sa kaniya.
en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

tgl: At sinabi, Bitawan mo ako, sapagka't nagbubukang liwayway na. At kaniyang sinabi, Hindi kita bibitawan hanggang hindi mo ako mabasbasan.
en: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kaniya, Ano ang pangalan mo? At kaniyang sinabi, Jacob.
en: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

tgl: At sinabi niya, Hindi na tatawaging Jacob ang iyong pangalan, kundi Israel; sapagka't ikaw ay nakipagpunyagi sa Dios at sa mga tao, at ikaw ay nanaig.
en: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed. <sup>Israel: that is, A prince of God</sup>

tgl: At siya'y tinanong ni Jacob, at sinabi, Ipinamamanhik ko sa iyong sabihin mo sa akin ang iyong pangalan. At kaniyang sinabi, Bakit nagtatanong ka ng aking pangalan? At siya'y binasbasan doon.
en: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

tgl: At tinawag ni Jacob ang pangalan ng dakong yaon na Peniel; sapagka't aniya'y nakita ko ang Dios ng mukhaan, at naligtas ang aking buhay.
en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved. <sup>Peniel: that is, The face of God</sup>

tgl: At sinikatan siya ng araw ng siya'y nagdadaan sa Penuel; at siya'y napipilay sa hita niya.
en: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

tgl: Kaya't hindi kumakain ang mga anak ni Israel ng litid ng balakang na nasa kasukasuan ng hita, hanggang ngayon: sapagka't hinipo ng taong yaon ang kasukasuan ng hita ni Jacob, sa litid ng pigi.
en: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.

tgl: At itiningin ni Jacob ang kaniyang mga mata at tumingin, at, narito, si Esau ay dumarating, at kasama niya'y apat na raang tao. At kaniyang binahagi ang mga bata kay Lea at kay Raquel, at sa dalawang alilang babae.
en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

tgl: At inilagay niya ang mga alila na kasama ng kanilang mga anak na pinakapanguna, at si Lea na kasama ng kaniyang mga anak na pinakapangalawa, at si Raquel at si Jose na pinakahuli.
en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

tgl: At siya naman ay lumagpas sa unahan nila, at yumukod sa lupa na makapito, hanggang sa nalapit sa kaniyang kapatid.
en: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

tgl: At tumakbo si Esau na sinalubong siya, at niyakap siya at niyapos siya sa leeg, at hinagkan siya: at nagiyakan,
en: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

tgl: At itiningin ni Esau ang mga mata niya, at nakita ang mga babae at ang mga bata, at sinabi, Sinosino itong mga kasama mo? At kaniyang sinabi, Ang mga anak na ipinagkaloob ng Dios sa iyong lingkod.
en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant. <sup>with: Heb. to thee</sup>

tgl: Nang magkagayo'y nagsilapit ang mga alilang babae, sila at ang kanilang mga anak, at nagsiyukod.
en: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

tgl: At lumapit din si Lea at ang kaniyang mga anak, at nagsiyukod: at pagkatapos ay nagsilapit si Jose at si Raquel, at nagsiyukod.
en: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

tgl: At kaniyang sinabi, Anong palagay mo sa buong karamihang ito na nasumpungan ko? At kaniyang sinabi, Nang makasundo ng biyaya sa paningin ng aking panginoon.
en: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord. <sup>What: Heb. What is all this band to thee?</sup>

tgl: At sinabi ni Esau, Mayroon akong kasiya; kapatid ko, ariin mo ang iyo.
en: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself. <sup>keep: Heb. be that to thee that is thine</sup>

tgl: At sinabi sa kaniya ni Jacob, Hindi, ipinamamanhik ko sa iyo, na kung ngayo'y nakasundo ako ng biyaya sa iyong paningin, ay tanggapin mo nga ang aking kaloob sa aking kamay: yamang nakita ko ang iyong mukha, na gaya ng nakakakita ng mukha ng Dios, at ikaw ay nalugod sa akin.
en: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

tgl: Tanggapin mo, ipinamamanhik ko sa iyo, ang kaloob na dala sa iyo; sapagka't ipinagkaloob sa akin ng Dios, at mayroon ako ng lahat. At ipinilit sa kaniya, at kaniyang tinanggap.
en: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it. <sup>enough: Heb. all things</sup>

tgl: At kaniyang sinabi, Yumaon tayo at tayo'y lumakad, at ako'y mangunguna sa iyo.
en: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kaniya, Nalalaman ng aking panginoon na ang mga bata ay mahihina pa at ang mga kawan at ang mga baka ay nagpapasuso: at kung ipagmadali sa isa lamang araw ay mamamatay ang lahat ng kawan.
en: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

tgl: Magpauna ang aking panginoon sa kaniyang lingkod: at ako'y mamamatnubay na dahandahan, ayon sa hakbang ng mga hayop na nasa aking unahan, at ng hakbang ng mga bata, hanggang sa makarating ako sa aking panginoon sa Seir.
en: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir. <sup>according: Heb. according to the foot of the work, etc., and according to the foot of the children</sup>

tgl: At sinabi ni Esau, Pahintulutan mong iwan ko sa iyo ang ilan sa mga taong kasama ko. At kaniyang sinabi, Ano pang dahil nito? Makasundo nawa ako ng biyaya sa paningin ng aking panginoon.
en: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord. <sup>leave: Heb. set, or, place</sup> <sup>What: Heb. Wherefore is this?</sup>

tgl: Gayon nagbalik si Esau ng araw ding yaon sa kaniyang lakad sa Seir.
en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

tgl: At si Jacob ay naglakbay sa Succoth, at nagtayo ng isang bahay para sa kaniya, at iginawa niya ng mga balag ang kaniyang hayop: kaya't tinawag ang pangalan ng dakong yaon na Succoth.
en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth. <sup>Succoth: that is, Booths</sup>

tgl: At dumating si Jacob na payapa sa bayan ng Sichem, na nasa lupain ng Canaan, nang siya'y manggaling sa Padan-aram; at siya'y humantong sa tapat ng bayan.
en: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city. <sup>Shechem: Gr. Sychem</sup>

tgl: At binili ang pitak ng lupa na pinagtayuan ng kaniyang tolda, sa kamay ng mga anak ni Hamor, na ama ni Sichem, ng isang daang putol na salapi.
en: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money. <sup>Hamor: Gr. Emmor</sup> <sup>pieces: or, lambs</sup>

tgl: At siya'y nagtindig doon ng isang dambana, at tinawag niyang El-Elohe-Israel.
en: And he erected there an altar, and called it Elelohe-Israel. <sup>Elelohe-Israel: that is God the God of Israel</sup>

tgl: At lumabas si Dina na anak ni Lea, na ipinanganak nito kay Jacob, upang tingnan ang mga anak na babae ng lupaing yaon.
en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

tgl: At siya'y nakita ni Sichem, anak ni Hamor, na Heveo, na prinsipe sa lupain; at siya'y kinuha at sumiping sa kaniya, at siya'y pinangayupapa.
en: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her. <sup>defiled: Heb. humbled her</sup>

tgl: At inilakip niya ang kaniyang kaluluwa kay Dina, na anak ni Jacob at kaniyang sininta ang dalaga, at nakiusap ng kalugodlugod sa dalaga.
en: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel. <sup>kindly: Heb. to the heart of the damsel</sup>

tgl: At si Sichem ay nagsalita sa kaniyang amang kay Hamor, na sinabi, Ipakamit mo sa akin ang dalagang ito na maging asawa ko.
en: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

tgl: Nabalitaan nga ni Jacob na dinahas ang kaniyang anak na si Dina; at ang kaniyang mga anak ay nasa kasamahan ng mga hayop niya sa parang: at tumahimik si Jacob hanggang sa sila'y dumating.
en: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

tgl: At nilabas ni Hamor na ama ni Sichem si Jacob upang makiusap sa kaniya.
en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

tgl: At ang mga anak ni Jacob ay nagsiuwi mula sa parang nang kanilang mabalitaan: at nangagdamdam ang mga lalake, at nagningas ang kanilang galit, sapagka't gumawa ng kaululan sa Israel, na sinipingan ang anak ni Jacob; bagay na di nararapat gawin.
en: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

tgl: At nakiusap si Hamor sa kanila, na sinasabi, Ang kaluluwa ni Sichem na aking anak ay sumasa iyong anak; ipinamamanhik ko sa inyo na ipagkaloob ninyo sa kaniya na maging asawa niya.
en: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

tgl: At magsipagasawa kayo sa amin; ibigay ninyo sa amin ang inyong mga anak na babae, at ibibigay namin sa inyo ang aming mga anak na babae.
en: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

tgl: At tatahan kayong kasama namin; at ang lupain ay sasa harap ninyo; tumahan kayo at mangalakal kayo riyan at magkaroon kayo ng mga pag-aari riyan.
en: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

tgl: At sinabi ni Sichem sa ama ni Dina, at sa mga kapatid niya, Makasundo nawa ako ng biyaya sa inyong mga mata at ang sabihin ninyo sa akin ay aking ibibigay.
en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

tgl: Hingin ninyo sa akin ang walang bilang na bigay-kaya at kaloob, at aking ibibigay ayon sa sabihin ninyo sa akin; ipagkaloob lamang ninyo sa akin ang dalaga na maging asawa ko.
en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

tgl: At nagsisagot na may pagdaraya ang mga anak ni Jacob kay Sichem at kay Hamor na kaniyang ama, at sila'y nagsalitaan, sapagka't kaniyang dinahas si Dina na kanilang kapatid.
en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kanila, Hindi namin magagawa ito, na ibigay ang aming kapatid sa isang hindi tuli; sapagka't isang kasiraan ng puri namin.
en: And they said unto them, We cannot  do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

tgl: Sa ganitong paraan lamang papayag kami sa inyo: kung kayo'y magiging gaya namin, na mangatuli ang lahat ng lalake sa inyo;
en: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;

tgl: Ay ibibigay nga namin sa inyo ang aming mga anak na babae, at makikisama kami sa inyong mga anak na babae, at tatahan kami sa inyo, at tayo'y magiging isa lamang bayan.
en: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

tgl: Datapuwa't kung ayaw ninyo kaming pakinggan, na kayo'y mangatuli; ay dadalhin nga namin ang aming anak na babae at kami ay yayaon.
en: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

tgl: At ang kanilang mga salita ay kinalugdan ni Hamor at ni Sichem, na anak ni Hamor.
en: And their words pleased  Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.

tgl: At hindi iniliban ng binata ang paggawa niyaon, sapagka't nalugod siya sa anak na babae ni Jacob: at siya ang pinarangalang higit sa buong sangbahayan ng kaniyang ama.
en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.

tgl: At si Hamor at si Sichem na kaniyang anak ay napasa pintuang-bayan ng kanilang bayan, at sila'y nakiusap sa mga tao sa kanilang bayan, na sinasabi.
en: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

tgl: Ang mga taong ito ay tahimik sa atin; kaya't magsitahan sila sa lupain at magsipangalakal sila riyan; sapagka't narito, ang lupain, ay may malabis na kaluwangan sa kanila; tayo'y makisama sa kanilang mga anak na babae, at ating ibigay sa kanila ang ating mga anak.
en: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

tgl: Sa ganito lamang paraan papayagan tayo ng mga taong iyan, sa pagtahan sa atin, na maging isa lamang bayan, kung patuli ang lahat ng lalake sa atin, na gaya naman nila na mga tuli.
en: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

tgl: Di ba magiging atin ang kanilang mga baka at ang kanilang mga pag-aari at ang lahat nilang hayop? Atin lamang silang payagan, at tatahan sa atin.
en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

tgl: At pinakinggan si Hamor at si Sichem na kaniyang anak, ng lahat na lumalabas sa pintuan ng kaniyang bayan; at ang lahat ng lalake ay nagtuli, ang lahat ng lumalabas sa pintuan ng kaniyang bayan.
en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

tgl: At nangyari, nang ikatlong araw, nang sila'y nangasasaktan, na ang dalawa sa mga anak ni Jacob, si Simeon at si Levi, na mga kapatid ni Dina, na kumuha ang bawa't isa ng kaniyang tabak, at sila'y lihim na pumasok sa bayan, at kanilang pinatay ang lahat ng mga lalake.
en: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

tgl: At kanilang pinatay si Hamor at si Sichem na kaniyang anak, sa talim ng tabak, at kanilang kinuha si Dina sa bahay ni Sichem, at sila'y nagsialis.
en: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out. <sup>edge: Heb. mouth</sup>

tgl: Nagsiparoon ang mga anak ni Jacob sa mga patay, at kanilang sinamsaman ang bayan, sapagka't kanilang dinahas ang kapatid nila.
en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

tgl: Kinuha nila ang kanilang mga kawan at ang kanilang mga bakahan, at ang kanilang mga asno, at ang nasa bayan, at ang nasa parang;
en: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

tgl: At ang kanilang buong yaman, at ang lahat ng kanilang mga anak, at mga asawa, ay dinala nilang bihag at samsam, sa makatuwid baga'y lahat na nasa bahay.
en: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

tgl: At sinabi ni Jacob kay Simeon at kay Levi, Ako'y inyong binagabag, na pinapaging mapagtanim ninyo ako sa mga tumatahan sa lupain, sa mga Cananeo, at sa mga Pherezeo; at akong may kaunting tao, ay magpipisan sila laban sa akin, at ako'y sasaktan nila; at lilipulin ako at ang aking sangbahayan.
en: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

tgl: At kanilang sinabi, Aariin ba niya ang aming kapatid na parang isang patutot?
en: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

tgl: At sinabi ng Dios kay Jacob, Tumindig ka, umahon ka sa Bethel, at tumahan ka roon; at gumawa ka roon ng isang dambana sa Dios na napakita sa iyo nang ikaw ay tumatakas mula sa harap ng iyong kapatid na si Esau.
en: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

tgl: Nang magkagayo'y sinabi ni Jacob sa kaniyang sangbahayan, at sa lahat niyang kasama. Ihiwalay ninyo ang mga dios ng iba na nangasa inyo, at magpakalinis kayo, at magbago kayo ng inyong mga suot:
en: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

tgl: At tayo'y magsitindig at magsisampa tayo sa Bethel; at gagawa ako roon ng dambana sa Dios na sumagot sa akin sa araw ng aking kahapisan, at sumaakin sa daan na aking nilakaran.
en: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

tgl: At kanilang ibinigay kay Jacob ang lahat ng ibang pinaka dios na nasa kamay nila, at ang mga hikaw na nasa kanilang mga tainga; at itinago ni Jacob sa ilalim ng punong encina na malapit sa Sichem.
en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

tgl: At sila'y naglakbay; at ang isang malaking sindak mula sa Dios ay sumabayan na nasa mga palibot nila, at hindi nila hinabol ang mga anak ni Jacob.
en: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

tgl: Sa gayo'y naparoon si Jacob sa Luz, na nasa lupain ng Canaan (na siyang Bethel), siya at ang buong bayang kasama niya.
en: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.

tgl: At siya'y nagtayo roon ng isang dambana at tinawag niya ang dakong yaon na El-beth-el; sapagka't ang Dios ay napakita sa kaniya roon, nang siya'y tumatakas sa harap ng kaniyang kapatid.
en: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother. <sup>Elbethel: that is, The God of Bethel</sup>

tgl: At namatay si Debora na yaya ni Rebeca, at nalibing sa paanan ng Bethel, sa ilalim ng encina, na ang pangalan ay tinawag na Allon-bacuth.
en: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth. <sup>Allonbachuth: that is, The oak of weeping</sup>

tgl: At ang Dios ay napakita uli kay Jacob, nang siya'y manggaling sa Padan-aram, at siya'y pinagpala.
en: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.

tgl: At sinabi sa kaniya ng Dios, Ang pangalan mo'y Jacob; ang pangalan mo'y hindi na tatawagin pang Jacob kundi Israel ang itatawag sa iyo: at tinawag ang kaniyang pangalan na Israel.
en: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

tgl: At sinabi sa kaniya ng Dios, Ako ang Dios na Makapangyarihan sa lahat; ikaw ay lumago at dumami ka; isang bansa at isang kapisanan ng mga bansa ang magmumula sa iyo, at mga hari ay lalabas sa iyong balakang;
en: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

tgl: At ang lupaing ibinigay ko kay Abraham at kay Isaac, ay ibibigay ko sa iyo, at sa iyong lahi pagkamatay mo ay ibibigay ko ang lupain.
en: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

tgl: At ang Dios ay napailanglang mula sa tabi niya sa dakong pinakipagusapan sa kaniya.
en: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

tgl: At si Jacob ay nagtayo ng isang batong pinakaalaala sa dakong pinakipagusapan sa kaniya ng Dios, haliging bato: at binuhusan niya ng isang inuming handog at binuhusan niya ng langis.
en: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

tgl: At tinawag ni Jacob na Bethel ang dakong pinakipagusapan sa kaniya ng Dios.
en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.

tgl: At sila'y naglakbay mula sa Bethel; at may kalayuan pa upang dumating sa Ephrata: at nagdamdam si Raquel, at siya'y naghihirap sa panganganak.
en: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour. <sup>a little: Heb. a little piece of ground</sup>

tgl: At nangyari, nang siya'y naghihirap sa panganganak, na sinabi sa kaniya ng hilot, Huwag kang matakot, sapagka't magkakaroon ka ng isa pang anak na lalake.
en: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

tgl: At nangyari, nang nalalagot ang kaniyang hininga (sapagka't namatay siya), ay kaniyang pinanganlang Benoni: datapuwa't pinanganlan ng kaniyang ama na Benjamin.
en: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin. <sup>Benoni: that is, The son of my sorrow</sup> <sup>Benjamin: that is, The son of the right hand</sup>

tgl: At namatay si Raquel at inilibing sa daang patungo sa Ephrata (na siyang Bethlehem).
en: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.

tgl: At nagtayo si Jacob ng isang batong pinakaalaala sa ibabaw ng kaniyang libingan: na siyang batong pinakaalaala ng libingan ni Raquel hanggang ngayon.
en: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.

tgl: At naglakbay si Israel at iniladlad ang kaniyang tolda sa dako pa roon ng moog ng Eder.
en: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

tgl: At nangyari, samantalang tumatahan si Israel sa lupaing yaon, na si Ruben ay yumaon at sumiping kay Bilha, na babae ng kaniyang ama; at ito'y nabalitaan ni Israel. Labing dalawa nga ang anak na lalake ni Jacob.
en: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve :

tgl: Ang mga anak ni Lea, ay: si Ruben, na panganay ni Jacob, at si Simeon, at si Levi, at si Juda at si Issachar, at si Zabulon.
en: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

tgl: Ang mga anak ni Raquel, ay: si Jose at si Benjamin:
en: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

tgl: At ang mga anak ni Bilha, na alila ni Raquel, ay: si Dan at si Nephtali:
en: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

tgl: At ang mga anak ni Zilpa na alilang babae ni Lea, ay: si Gad at si Aser: ito ang mga anak ni Jacob na ipinanganak sa kaniya sa Padan-aram.
en: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.

tgl: At naparoon si Jacob kay Isaac na kaniyang ama, sa Mamre, sa Kiriat-arba (na siyang Hebron), na doon tumahan si Abraham at si Isaac.
en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

tgl: At ang mga naging araw ni Isaac ay isang daan at walong pung taon.
en: And the days of Isaac were an hundred  and fourscore years.

tgl: At nalagot ang hininga ni Isaac at namatay, at siya'y nalakip sa kaniyang bayan, matanda at puspos ng mga araw: at inilibing siya ng kaniyang mga anak na si Esau at si Jacob.
en: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

tgl: Ito nga ang mga lahi ni Esau (na siyang Edom).
en: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

tgl: Si Esau ay nagasawa sa mga anak ng Canaan; kay Ada na anak ni Elon na Hethoh, at kay Aholibama, anak ni Ana na anak ni Zibeon na Heveo.
en: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

tgl: At kay Basemath na anak ni Ismael, na kapatid ni Nabaiot.
en: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

tgl: At ipinanganak si Eliphaz ni Ada kay Esau; at ipinanganak ni Basemath si Reuel;
en: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

tgl: At ipinanganak ni Aholibama si Jeus, at si Jaalam at si Cora; ito ang mga anak ni Esau, na ipinanganak sa kaniya sa lupain ng Canaan.
en: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

tgl: At dinala ni Esau ang kaniyang mga asawa, at ang kaniyang mga anak na lalake at babae, at ang lahat ng tao sa kaniyang bahay, at ang kaniyang hayop, at ang lahat ng kaniyang kawan, at ang lahat niyang tinatangkilik na kaniyang tinipon sa lupain ng Canaan; at napasa ibang lupaing bukod kay Jacob na kaniyang kapatid.
en: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob. <sup>persons: Heb. souls</sup>

tgl: Sapagka't ang kanilang pag-aari ay totoong napakalaki para sa kanila na tumahang magkasama at ang lupain na kanilang pinaglakbayan ay hindi makaya sila, sapagka't napakarami ang kanilang hayop.
en: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.

tgl: At tumahan si Esau sa bundok ng Seir: si Esau ay siyang Edom.
en: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

tgl: At ito ang mga lahi ni Esau, na ama ng mga Edomita sa bundok ng Seir:
en: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir: <sup>the Edomites: Heb. Edom</sup>

tgl: Ito ang mga pangalan ng mga anak ni Esau: si Eliphas, na anak ni Ada na asawa ni Esau, si Reuel na anak ni Basemath, na asawa ni Esau.
en: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

tgl: At ang mga anak ni Eliphaz, ay si Teman, si Omar, si Zepho, si Gatham at si Cenaz.
en: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz. <sup>Zepho: or, Zephi</sup>

tgl: At si Timna ay babae ni Eliphaz na anak ni Esau; at ipinanganak niya kay Eliphaz si Amalec; ito ang mga anak ni Ada na asawa ni Esau.
en: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.

tgl: At ito ang mga anak ni Reuel; si Nahat, si Zera, si Samma at si Mizza: ito ang mga anak ni Basemath na asawa ni Esau.
en: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

tgl: At ito ang mga anak ni Aholibama, na anak ni Ana, na anak ni Zibeon, na asawa ni Esau: at ipinanganak niya kay Esau: si Jeus at si Jaalam at si Cora.
en: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

tgl: Ito ang mga pangulo sa mga anak ni Esau: ang mga anak ni Eliphaz, na panganay ni Esau; ang pangulong Teman, ang pangulong Omar, ang pangulong Zepho, ang pangulong Cenaz,
en: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,

tgl: Ang pangulong Cora, ang pangulong Gatam, ang pangulong Amalec: ito ang mga pangulong nagmula kay Eliphaz sa lupain ng Edom; ito ang mga anak ni Ada.
en: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.

tgl: At ito ang mga anak ni Reuel na anak ni Esau; ang pangulong Nahath, ang pangulong Zera, ang pangulong Samma ang pangulong Mizza: ito ang mga pangulong nagmula kay Reuel sa lupain ng Edom; ito ang mga anak ni Basemath, na asawa ni Esau.
en: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

tgl: At ito ang mga anak ni Aholibama na asawa ni Esau; ang pangulong Jeus, ang pangulong Jaalam, ang pangulong Cora: ito ang mga pangulong nagmula kay Aholibama na anak ni Ana, na asawa ni Esau.
en: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

tgl: Ito ang mga anak ni Esau, at ito ang kanilang mga pangulo: na siyang Edom.
en: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.

tgl: Ito ang mga anak ni Seir na Horeo, na nagsisitahan sa lupain; si Lotan at si Sobal, at si Zibeon, at si Ana,
en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

tgl: At si Dison, at si Ezer, at si Disan: ito ang mga pangulong nagmula sa mga Horeo, na mga angkan ni Seir sa lupain ng Edom.
en: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

tgl: At ang mga anak ni Lotan, ay si Hori at si Heman; at ang kapatid na babae ni Lotan ay si Timna.
en: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna. <sup>Hemam: or, Homam</sup>

tgl: At ito ang mga anak ni Sobal; si Alvan, at si Manahath, at si Ebal, si Zepho, at si Onam.
en: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. <sup>Alvan: or, Alian</sup> <sup>Shepho: or, Shephi</sup>

tgl: At ito ang mga anak ni Zibeon; si Aja at si Ana: ito rin ang si Ana na nakasumpong ng maiinit na bukal sa ilang, nang pinapanginginain ang mga asno ni Zibeon na kaniyang ama.
en: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

tgl: At ito ang mga anak ni Ana; si Dison at si Aholibama, na anak na babae ni Ana.
en: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

tgl: At ito ang mga anak ni Dizon: si Hemdan, at si Eshban, at si Ithram, at si Cheran.
en: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran. <sup>Hemdan: or, Amram</sup>

tgl: Ito ang mga anak ni Ezer: si Bilhan, at si Zaavan at si Acan.
en: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan. <sup>Akan: or, Jakan</sup>

tgl: Ito ang mga anak ni Disan: si Huz at si Aran.
en: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.

tgl: Ito ang mga pangulong nagmula sa mga Horeo; ang pangulong Lotan, ang pangulong Sobal, ang pangulong Zibeon, ang pangulong Ana,
en: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

tgl: Ang pangulong Dison, ang pangulong Ezer, ang pangulong Disan: ito ang mga pangulong nagmula sa mga Horeo ayon sa kanilang mga pangulo, sa lupain ng Seir.
en: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

tgl: At ito ang mga hari na nagsipaghari sa lupain ng Edom bago maghari ang sinomang hari sa angkan ni Israel.
en: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

tgl: At si Bela na anak ni Beor ay naghari sa Edom; at ang pangalan ng kaniyang bayan ay Dinaba.
en: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

tgl: At namatay si Bela, at naghari na kahalili niya si Jobab na anak ni Zera, na taga Bozra.
en: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

tgl: At namatay si Jobab at naghari na kahalili niya si Husam, na taga lupain ng mga Temaneo.
en: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

tgl: At namatay si Husam, at naghari na kahalili niya si Adad, na anak ni Badad, na siya ring sumakit kay Midian sa parang ni Moab: at ang pangalan ng kaniyang bayan ay Avita.
en: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

tgl: At namatay si Adad at naghari na kahalili niya si Samla na taga Masreca.
en: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

tgl: At namatay si Samla at naghari na kahalili niya si Saul, na taga Rehoboth na tabi ng Ilog.
en: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

tgl: At namatay si Saul, at naghari na kahalili niya si Baalanan na anak ni Achbor.
en: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

tgl: At namatay si Baalanan na anak ni Achbor, at naghari na kahalili niya si Adar; at ang pangalan ng kaniyang bayan ay Pau; at ang pangalan ng kaniyang asawa ay Meetabel na anak ni Matred, na anak na babae ni Mezaab.
en: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab. <sup>Hadar, Pau: or, Hadad, Pai: after his death was an Aristocracy</sup>

tgl: At ito ang mga pangalan ng mga pangulong nagmula kay Esau, ayon sa kanikaniyang angkan, ayon sa kanikaniyang dako, alinsunod sa kanikaniyang pangalan; ang pangulong Timma, ang pangulong Alva, ang pangulong Jetheth;
en: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth, <sup>Alvah: or, Aliah</sup>

tgl: Ang pangulong Aholibama, ang pangulong Ela, ang pangulong Pinon.
en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

tgl: Ang pangulong Cenaz, ang pangulong Teman, ang pangulong Mibzar.
en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

tgl: Ang pangulong Magdiel, ang pangulong Hiram: ito ang mga pangulo ni Edom, ayon sa kanikaniyang tahanan sa lupain na kanilang pag-aari. Ito'y si Esau na ama ng mga Edomita.
en: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites. <sup>the Edomites: Heb. Edom</sup>

tgl: At tumahan si Jacob sa lupaing pinangibahang lupain ng kaniyang ama, sa lupain ng Canaan.
en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan. <sup>wherein: Heb. of his father's sojournings</sup>

tgl: Ito ang lahi ni Jacob. Si Jose, na may labing pitong taon, ay nagpapastol ng kawan na kasama ng kaniyang mga kapatid; at siya'y batang kasamahan ng mga anak ni Bilha at ng mga anak ni Zilpa, na mga asawa ng kaniyang ama; at ibinalita ni Jose sa kanilang ama ang kasamaan nila.
en: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen  years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

tgl: Minamahal nga ni Israel si Jose ng higit kay sa lahat niyang anak, sapagka't siya ang anak ng kaniyang katandaan: at siya'y iginawa ng isang tunika na may sarisaring kulay.
en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours. <sup>colours: or, pieces</sup>

tgl: At nakita ng kaniyang mga kapatid na siya'y minamahal ng kanilang ama ng higit kay sa lahat niyang kapatid; at siya'y kinapootan, at hindi nila mapagsalitaan siya ng payapa.
en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

tgl: At nanaginip si Jose ng isang panaginip, at isinaysay sa kaniyang mga kapatid: at lalo pa nilang kinapootan siya.
en: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kanila. Pakinggan ninyo, ipinamamanhik ko sa inyo, itong panaginip na aking napanaginip:
en: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

tgl: Sapagka't, narito, tayo'y nagtatali ng mga bigkis ng trigo sa bukid, at, narito, na tumindig ang aking bigkis, at tumuwid din naman at, narito, ang inyong mga bigkis ay napasa palibot at yumukod sa aking bigkis.
en: For, behold, we were binding  sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

tgl: At sa kaniya'y sinabi ng kaniyang mga kapatid, Maghahari ka ba sa amin? o papapanginoon ka sa amin? At lalo pa siyang kinapootan nila dahil sa kaniyang mga panaginip at sa kaniyang mga salita.
en: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

tgl: At siya'y nanaginip pa ng ibang panaginip, at isinaysay sa kaniyang mga kapatid, at sinabi, Narito, ako'y nanaginip pa ng isang panaginip; at narito, na ang araw, at ang buwan at ang labing isang bituin ay yumukod sa akin.
en: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven  stars made obeisance to me.

tgl: At kaniyang isinaysay sa kaniyang ama at sa kaniyang mga kapatid; at sinaway siya ng kaniyang ama, at sa kaniya'y sinabi, Anong panaginip itong iyong napanaginip? Tunay bang ako at ang iyong ina at ang iyong mga kapatid ay yuyukod sa lupa sa harap mo?
en: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

tgl: At ang kaniyang mga kapatid ay nainggit sa kaniya: datapuwa't iningatan ng kaniyang ama ang salita sa pagiisip.
en: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

tgl: At yumaon ang kaniyang mga kapatid upang magpastol ng kawan ng kanilang ama, sa Sichem.
en: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.

tgl: At sinabi ni Israel kay Jose, Di ba nagpapastol ng kawan sa Sichem ang iyong mga kapatid? Halika, at uutusan kita sa kanila. At sinabi niya sa kaniya, Narito ako.
en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.

tgl: At kaniyang sinabi sa kaniya, Yumaon ka, tingnan mo kung mabuti ang lagay ng iyong mga kapatid, at kung mabuti ang lagay ng kawan; at balitaan mo ako. Gayon sinugo siya mula sa libis ng Hebron, at siya'y naparoon sa Sichem.
