en: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she  was of a great  age , and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

tgl: At siya'y bao nang walongpu't apat na taon), na hindi humihiwalay sa templo, at sumasamba sa gabi at araw sa pamamagitan ng mga pagaayuno at mga pagdaing.
en: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

tgl: At pagdating niya sa oras ding yaon, siya'y nagpasalamat sa Dios, at nagsalita ng tungkol sa sanggol sa lahat ng nagsisipaghintay ng katubusan sa Jerusalem.
en: And she  coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem. <sup>Jerusalem: or, Israel</sup>

tgl: At nang maganap na nila ang lahat ng mga bagay na alinsunod sa kautusan ng Panginoon, ay nangagbalik sila sa Galilea, sa kanilang sariling bayang Nazaret.
en: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

tgl: At lumalaki ang bata, at lumalakas, at napupuspos ng karunungan: at sumasa kaniya ang biyaya ng Dios.
en: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

tgl: At nagsisiparoon taon-taon ang kaniyang mga magulang sa Jerusalem sa kapistahan ng paskua.
en: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

tgl: At nang siya'y may labindalawang taon na, ay nagsiahon sila ayon sa kaugalian ng kapistahan;
en: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

tgl: At nang kanilang maganap na ang mga araw, sa pagbalik nila, ay naiwan ang batang si Jesus sa Jerusalem; at di nalalaman ng kaniyang mga magulang;
en: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

tgl: Nguni't sa pagaakala nilang siya'y nasa kasamahan, ay nagsiyaon sila nang isang araw na paglalakbay; at hinahanap nila siya sa mga kamaganak at mga kakilala;
en: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and  acquaintance.

tgl: At nang di nila siya matagpuan, ay nagsipagbalik sila sa Jerusalem, na hinahanap siya.
en: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

tgl: At nangyari, na nang makaraan ang tatlong araw, ay nangatagpuan nila siya sa templo, na nakaupo sa gitna ng mga guro, na sila'y pinakikinggan, at sila'y tinatanong:
en: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

tgl: At ang lahat ng sa kaniya'y nangakakarinig ay nagsisipanggilalas sa kaniyang katalinuhan at sa kaniyang mga sagot.
en: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

tgl: At nang siya'y mangakita nila, ay nangagtaka sila; at sinabi sa kaniya ng kaniyang ina, Anak, bakit ginawa mo sa amin ang ganyan? narito, ang iyong ama at ako na hinahanap kang may hapis.
en: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kanila, Bakit ninyo ako hinahanap? di baga talastas ninyo na dapat akong maglumagak sa bahay ng aking Ama.
en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

tgl: At di nila naunawa ang pananalitang sa kanila'y sinabi.
en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

tgl: At lumusong siyang kasama nila, at napasa Nazaret; at napasakop sa kanila: at iniingatan ng kaniyang ina sa kaniyang puso ang lahat ng mga pananalitang ito.
en: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

tgl: At lumalaki si Jesus sa karunungan at sa pangangatawan, at sa pagbibigay lugod sa Dios at sa mga tao.
en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man. <sup>stature: or, age</sup>

tgl: Nang ikalabinglimang taon nga ng paghahari ni Tiberio Cesar, na noo'y gobernador sa Judea si Poncio Pilato, at tetrarka sa Galilea si Herodes, at ang kaniyang kapatid na si Felipe ay tetrarka sa lalawigan ng Iturea at Traconite, at si Lisanias ay tetrarka sa Abilinia,
en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene, <sup>tetrarch: or, governor of four provinces</sup>

tgl: Nang kasalukuyang mga pangulong saserdote si Anas at si Caifas, ay dumating ang salita ng Dios kay Juan, anak ni Zacarias, sa ilang.
en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

tgl: At siya'y napasa buong lupain sa palibotlibot ng Jordan, na ipinangangaral ang bautismo ng pagsisisi sa ikapagpapatawad ng mga kasalanan;
en: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

tgl: Gaya ng nasusulat sa aklat ng salita ng propeta Isaias, Ang tinig ng isang sumisigaw sa ilang, Ihanda ninyo ang daan ng Panginoon, Tuwirin ninyo ang kaniyang mga landas.
en: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

tgl: Lahat ng libis ay tatambakan, At pababain ang bawa't bundok at burol; At ang liko ay matutuwid, At ang mga daang bakobako ay mangapapatag;
en: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

tgl: At makikita ng lahat ng laman ang pagliligtas ng Dios.
en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

tgl: Sinasabi nga niya sa mga karamihang nagsisilabas upang mangagpabautismo sa kaniya, Kayong lahi ng mga ulupong, sino ang sa inyo'y nagudyok upang tumakas sa galit na darating?
en: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

tgl: Kayo nga'y mangagbunga ng karapatdapat sa pagsisisi, at huwag mangagpasimulang mangagsabi sa inyong sarili, Si Abraham ang siya naming ama; sapagka't sinasabi ko sa inyo, na makapagpapabangon ang Dios ng mga anak ni Abraham maging sa mga batong ito.
en: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham. <sup>worthy of: or, meet for</sup>

tgl: At ngayon pa'y nakalagay na ang palakol sa ugat ng mga punong kahoy: ang bawa't punong kahoy nga na di nagbubunga ng mabuti ay pinuputol, at inihahagis sa apoy.
en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

tgl: At tinanong siya ng karamihan, na nangagsasabi, Ano ngang dapat namin gawin?
en: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

tgl: At sinagot niya at sinabi sa kanila, Ang may dalawang tunika ay magbahagi sa wala; at ang may pagkain ay gayon din ang gawin.
en: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

tgl: At dumating naman ang mga maniningil ng buwis upang mangagpabautismo, at sinabi nila sa kaniya, Guro, anong dapat naming gawin?
en: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kanila, Huwag na kayong sumingil pa ng higit kay sa utos sa inyo.
en: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

tgl: At tinanong naman siya ng mga kawal, na nangagsasabi, At kami, anong dapat naming gawin? At sa kanila'y sinabi niya, Huwag kayong kumuhang may karahasan sa kanino man, ni mangagparatang; at mangagkasiya kayo sa bayad sa inyo.
en: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages. <sup>Do violence: or, Put no man in fear</sup> <sup>wages: or, allowance</sup>

tgl: At samantalang ang mga tao'y nagsisipaghintay at pinagbubulaybulay ng lahat sa kanilang puso ang tungkol kay Juan, kung siya kaya ang Cristo;
en: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not; <sup>in expectation: or, in suspense</sup> <sup>mused: or, reasoned, or, debated</sup>

tgl: Ay sumagot si Juan na sinasabi sa kanilang lahat, Katotohanang binabautismuhan ko kayo ng tubig; datapuwa't dumarating ang lalong makapangyarihan kay sa akin; ako'y hindi karapatdapat magkalag ng panali ng kaniyang mga pangyapak: kayo'y babautismuhan niya sa Espiritu Santo at sa apoy:
en: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose  shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

tgl: Nasa kaniyang kamay ang kaniyang kalaykay, upang linising lubos ang kaniyang giikan, at tipunin ang trigo sa kaniyang bangan; datapuwa't susunugin niya ang dayami sa apoy na hindi mapapatay.
en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

tgl: Sa mga iba pang maraming pangaral ay ipinangangaral nga niya sa bayan ang mabuting balita;
en: And  many other things  in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

tgl: Datapuwa't si Herodes na tetrarka, palibhasa'y pinagwikaan niya dahil kay Herodias, na asawa ng kaniyang kapatid, at dahil sa lahat ng masasamang bagay na ginawa ni Herodes,
en: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

tgl: Ay naparagdag naman ito sa lahat, na kinulong niya si Juan sa bilangguan.
en: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

tgl: Nangyari nga, nang mabautismuhan ang buong bayan, na si Jesus ay binautismuhan naman, at nang nananalangin, ay nabuksan ang langit,
en: Now when all the people were baptized , it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

tgl: At bumaba sa kaniya ang Espiritu Santo na may anyong katawan, tulad sa isang kalapati, at nanggaling ang isang tinig sa langit, Ikaw ang sinisinta kong Anak; sa iyo ako lubos na nalulugod.
en: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

tgl: At si Jesus din, nang magpasimula siyang magturo ay may gulang na tatlongpung taon, na anak (ayon sa sinasapantaha) ni Jose, ni Eli,
en: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

tgl: Ni Matat, ni Levi, ni Melqui, ni Jane, ni Jose,
en: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,

tgl: Ni Matatias, ni Amos, ni Nahum, ni Esli, ni Nage,
en: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

tgl: Ni Maat, ni Matatias, ni Semei, ni Jose, ni Juda,
en: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

tgl: Ni Joana, ni Resa, ni Zorobabel, ni Seatiel, ni Neri,
en: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,

tgl: Ni Melqui, ni Adi, ni Cosam, ni Elmodam, ni Er,
en: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,

tgl: Ni Jesus, ni Eliezer, ni Jorim, ni Mata, ni Levi,
en: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,

tgl: Ni Simeon, ni Juda, ni Jose, ni Jonan, ni Eliaquim,
en: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,

tgl: Ni Melea, ni Mena, ni Matata, ni Natan, ni David,
en: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,

tgl: Ni Jesse, ni Obed, ni Booz, ni Salmon, ni Naason,
en: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,

tgl: Ni Aminadab, ni Aram, ni Esrom, ni Fares, ni Juda,
en: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,

tgl: Ni Jacob, ni Isaac, ni Abraham, ni Tare, ni Nacor,
en: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,

tgl: Ni Serug, ni Regan, ni Paleg, ni Heber, ni Selah,
en: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,

tgl: Ni Cainan, ni Arfaxjad, ni Sem, ni Noe, ni Lamec,
en: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,

tgl: Ni Matusalem, ni Enoc, ni Jared, ni Mahalaleel, ni Cainan,
en: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,

tgl: Ni Enos, ni Set, ni Adam, ng Dios.
en: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.

tgl: At si Jesus, na puspos ng Espiritu Santo ay bumalik mula sa Jordan at inihatid ng Espiritu sa ilang,
en: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

tgl: Sa loob ng apat na pung araw na tinutukso ng diablo. At hindi siya kumain ng anoman nang mga araw na yaon; at nang maganap ang mga yaon ay nagutom siya.
en: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing : and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

tgl: At sinabi sa kaniya ng diablo, Kung ikaw ang Anak ng Dios, ipag-utos mo na ang batong ito ay maging tinapay.
en: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

tgl: At sinagot siya ni Jesus, Nasusulat, Hindi sa tinapay lamang mabubuhay ang tao.
en: And Jesus answered him , saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

tgl: At iniakyat pa siya niya, at ipinakita sa kaniya sa sandaling panahon ang lahat ng mga kaharian sa sanglibutan.
en: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

tgl: At sinabi sa kaniya ng diablo, Sa iyo'y ibibigay ko ang lahat ng kapamahalaang ito, at ang kaluwalhatian nila: sapagka't ito'y naibigay na sa akin; at ibibigay ko kung kanino ko ibig.
en: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

tgl: Kaya nga kung sasamba ka sa harapan ko, ay magiging iyong lahat.
en: If thou therefore wilt worship me , all shall be thine. <sup>worship me: or, fall down before me</sup>

tgl: At si Jesus ay sumagot at sinabi sa kaniya, Nasusulat, Sa Panginoon mong Dios sasamba ka, at siya lamang ang iyong paglilingkuran.
en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

tgl: At dinala niya siya sa Jerusalem, at inilagay siya sa taluktok ng templo, at sinabi sa kaniya, Kung ikaw ay Anak ng Dios, ay magpatihulog ka mula rito hanggang sa ibaba:
en: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

tgl: Sapagka't nasusulat, Siya'y magbibilin sa kaniyang mga anghel tungkol sa iyo, upang ikaw ay ingatan:
en: For  it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

tgl: At, Aalalayan ka nila ng kanilang mga kamay, Baka matisod ka ng iyong paa sa isang bato.
en: And  in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

tgl: At pagsagot ni Jesus ay sinabi sa kaniya, Nasasabi, Huwag mong tutuksuhin ang Panginoon mong Dios.
en: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said , Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

tgl: At nang matapos ng diablo ang lahat ng pagtukso, ay hiniwalayan siya niya ng ilang panahon.
en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

tgl: At bumalik si Jesus sa Galilea sa kapangyarihan ng Espiritu: at kumalat ang kabantugan tungkol sa kaniya sa palibot ng buong lupain.
en: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

tgl: At nagtuturo siya sa mga sinagoga nila, na niluluwalhati ng lahat.
en: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

tgl: At siya'y napasa Nazaret na kaniyang nilakhan: at ayon sa kaniyang kaugalian, siya'y pumasok sa sinagoga nang araw ng sabbath, at nagtindig upang bumasa.
en: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

tgl: At ibinigay sa kaniya ang aklat ng propeta Isaias. At binuklat niya ang aklat, na nasumpungan niya ang dakong kinasusulatan,
en: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

tgl: Sumasa akin ang Espiritu ng Panginoon, Sapagka't ako'y pinahiran niya upang ipangaral ang mabubuting balita sa mga dukha: Ako'y sinugo niya upang itanyag sa mga bihag ang pagkaligtas, At sa mga bulag ang pagkakita, Upang bigyan ng kalayaan ang nangaaapi,
en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted , to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

tgl: Upang itanyag ang kaayaayang taon ng Panginoon.
en: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

tgl: At binalumbon niya ang aklat, at isinauli sa naglilingkod, at naupo: at ang mga mata ng lahat ng nangasa sinagoga ay nangakatitig sa kaniya.
en: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

tgl: At siya'y nagpasimulang magsabi sa kanila, Ngayo'y naganap ang kasulatang ito sa inyong mga pakinig.
en: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

tgl: At siya'y pinatotohanan ng lahat, at nangagtataka sa mga salita ng biyaya na lumalabas sa kaniyang bibig: at sinabi nila, Hindi baga ito ang anak ni Jose?
en: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kanila, Walang salang sasabihin ninyo sa akin itong talinghaga, Manggagamot, gamutin mo ang iyong sarili: ang anomang aming narinig na ginawa sa Capernaum, ay gawin mo naman dito sa iyong lupain.
en: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

tgl: At sinabi niya, Katotohanang sinasabi ko sa inyo, Walang propetang kinalulugdan sa kaniyang tinubuang lupa.
en: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

tgl: Datapuwa't katotohanang sinasabi ko sa inyo, Maraming mga baong babai sa Israel nang mga araw ni Elias, nang sarhan ang langit sa loob ng tatlong taon at anim na buwan, noong datnan ng malaking kagutom ang buong sangkalupaan;
en: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up  three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

tgl: At sa kanino man sa kanila ay hindi sinugo si Elias, kundi sa Sarepta sa lupa ng Sidon, sa isang babaing bao.
en: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

tgl: At maraming ketongin sa Israel nang panahon ni Eliseo na propeta; at sinoman sa kanila'y hindi nilinis, kundi lamang si Naaman na Siro.
en: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

tgl: At nangapuspos ng galit ang lahat ng nangasa sinagoga, sa pagkarinig nila ng mga bagay na ito;
en: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

tgl: At sila'y nagsitindig, at ipinagtabuyan siya sa labas ng bayan at dinala siya hanggang sa ibabaw ng taluktok ng gulod na kinatatayuan ng kanilang bayan, upang siya'y maibulid nila ng patiwarik.
en: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon  their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong. <sup>brow: or, edge</sup>

tgl: Datapuwa't pagdaraan niya sa gitna nila, ay yumaon ng kaniyang lakad.
en: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

tgl: At siya'y bumaba sa Capernaum, na isang bayan ng Galilea. At sila'y tinuruan niya sa araw ng sabbath:
en: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them  on the sabbath days.

tgl: At nangagtaka sila sa kaniyang aral, sapagka't may kapamahalaan ang kaniyang salita.
en: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

tgl: At sa sinagoga ay may isang lalake na may espiritu ng karumaldumal na demonio; at siya'y sumigaw ng malakas na tinig,
en: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

tgl: Ah! anong mayroon kami sa iyo, Jesus, ikaw na Nazareno? naparito ka baga upang kami'y iyong puksain? nakikilala ko ikaw kung sino ka, ang Banal ng Dios.
en: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God. <sup>Let: or, Away</sup>

tgl: At sinaway siya ni Jesus, na sinasabi, Tumahimik ka, at lumabas ka sa kaniya. At nang siya'y mailugmok ng demonio sa gitna, ay lumabas siya sa kaniya, na hindi siya sinaktan.
en: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

tgl: At silang lahat ay nangagtaka at nagsalitaan ang isa't isa, na nangagsasabi, Anong salita kaya ito? sapagka't siya na may kapamahalaan at kapangyarihan ay naguutos sa mga karumaldumal na espiritu, at nagsisilabas sila.
en: And they were all  amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

tgl: At kumakalat ang alingawngaw tungkol sa kaniya sa lahat ng dako sa palibotlibot ng lupaing yaon.
en: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

tgl: At siya'y nagtindig sa sinagoga, at pumasok sa bahay ni Simon. At nilalagnat na mainam ang biyanang babae ni Simon, at siya'y kanilang ipinamanhik sa kaniya.
en: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

tgl: At tinunghan niya siya, at sinaway ang lagnat; at inibsan siya: at siya'y nagtindig pagdaka at naglingkod sa kanila.
en: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

tgl: At nang lumulubog na ang araw, ang lahat na may mga sakit ng sarisaring karamdaman ay dinala sa kaniya; at ipinatong niya ang kaniyang mga kamay sa bawa't isa sa kanila, at sila'y pinagaling.
en: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

tgl: At nagsilabas din sa marami ang mga demonio na nagsisisigaw, na nagsasabi, Ikaw ang anak ng Dios. At sinasaway sila, na di niya sila tinutulutang mangagsalita, sapagka't naalaman nilang siya ang Cristo.
en: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ. <sup>to speak: or, to say that they knew him to be Christ</sup>

tgl: At nang araw na, ay lumabas siya at naparoon sa isang ilang na dako: at hinahanap siya ng mga karamihan, at nagsiparoon sa kaniya, at pinagpipilitang pigilin siya, upang huwag siyang humiwalay sa kanila.
en: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

tgl: Datapuwa't sinabi niya sa kanila, Dapat namang ipangaral ko sa mga ibang bayan ang mabubuting balita ng kaharian ng Dios: sapagka't sa ganito ay sinugo ako.
en: And he said unto them,  I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore  am I sent.

tgl: At siya'y nangangaral sa mga sinagoga ng Galilea.
en: And he preached  in the synagogues of Galilee.

tgl: Nangyari nga, na samantalang siya'y sinisiksik ng karamihan na pinakikinggan ang salita ng Dios, na siya'y nakatayo sa tabi ng dagatdagatan ng Genezaret;
en: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood  by the lake of Gennesaret,

tgl: At nakakita siya ng dalawang daong na nasa tabi ng dagatdagatan: datapuwa't nagsilunsad sa mga yaon ang mga mamamalakaya, at hinuhugasan ang kanilang mga lambat.
en: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

tgl: At lumulan siya sa isa sa mga daong, na kay Simon, at ipinamanhik niya dito na ilayo ng kaunti sa lupa. At siya'y naupo at nagturo sa mga karamihan buhat sa daong.
en: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

tgl: At pagtigil niya ng pagsasalita, ay sinabi niya kay Simon, Pumaroon ka sa laot, at ihulog ninyo ang inyong mga lambat upang mamalakaya.
en: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

tgl: At sumagot si Simon at sinabi, Guro, sa buong magdamag ay nagsipagpagal kami, at wala kaming nahuli: datapuwa't sa iyong salita ay ihuhulog ko ang mga lambat.
en: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all  the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

tgl: At nang magawa nila ito, ay nakahuli sila ng lubhang maraming isda; at nagkampupunit ang kanilang mga lambat;
en: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

tgl: At kinawayan nila ang mga kasamahan sa isang daong upang magsilapit at sila'y tulungan. At sila'y nagsilapit at nangapuno ang dalawang daong, ano pa't sila'y nagpasimulang lulubog.
en: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.

tgl: Datapuwa't nang makita ni Simon Pedro, ay nagpatirapa sa mga tuhod ni Jesus, na nagsasabi, Lumayo ka sa akin; sapagka't ako'y taong makasalanan, Oh Panginoon.
en: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

tgl: Sapagka't siya at ang lahat ng kasama niya ay nagsipanggilalas, dahil sa karamihan ng mga isdang kanilang nangahuli:
en: For he was astonished , and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

tgl: At gayon din si Santiago at si Juan, mga anak ni Zebedeo, na mga kasama ni Simon. At sinabi ni Jesus kay Simon, Huwag kang matakot; mula ngayon ay mamamalakaya ka ng mga tao.
en: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

tgl: At nang maisadsad na nila sa lupa ang kanilang mga daong, ay iniwan nila ang lahat, at nagsisunod sa kaniya.
en: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

tgl: At nangyari, samantalang siya'y nasa isa sa mga bayan, narito, may isang lalake na lipos ng ketong: at nang makita niya si Jesus, ay nagpatirapa siya, at namanhik sa kaniya, na sinasabi, Panginoon, kung ibig mo, ay maaaring linisin mo ako.
en: And it came to pass, when he was  in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

tgl: At iniunat niya ang kaniyang kamay at siya'y hinipo, na sinasabi, Ibig ko; luminis ka. At pagdaka'y nilisan siya ng ketong.
en: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

tgl: At ipinagbilin niya sa kaniya na huwag sabihin kanino man: kundi yumaon ka ng iyong lakad, at pakita ka sa saserdote, at maghandog ka sa pagkalinis sa iyo, alinsunod sa iniutos ni Moises, na pinakapatotoo sa kanila.
en: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

tgl: Datapuwa't lalo nang kumakalat ang balita tungkol sa kaniya: at nangagkatipon ang lubhang maraming tao upang makinig, at upang pagalingin sa kanilang mga sakit.
en: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

tgl: Datapuwa't siya'y lumigpit sa mga ilang, at nananalangin.
en: And he withdrew  himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

tgl: At nangyari nang isa sa mga araw na yaon, na siya'y nagtuturo; at may nangakaupo doong mga Fariseo at mga guro sa kautusan, na nagsipanggaling sa bawa't nayon ng Galilea at Judea at Jerusalem: at ang kapangyarihan ng Panginoon ay sumasa kaniya upang magpagaling.
en: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

tgl: At narito, dinala ng mga tao na nasa isang higaan ang isang lalaking lumpo: at pinagpipilitan niyang maipasok siya, at ilagay siya sa harap nila.
en: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

tgl: At sa hindi pagkasumpong ng mapagpapasukan, dahil sa karamihan, ay nagsiakyat sila sa bubungan ng bahay, at siya'y inihugos mula sa butas ng bubungan pati ng kaniyang higaan, sa gitna, sa harapan ni Jesus.
en: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

tgl: At pagkakita sa kanilang pananampalataya, ay kaniyang sinabi, Lalake, ipinatatawad sa iyo ang iyong mga kasalanan.
en: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

tgl: At ang mga eskriba at mga Fariseo ay nangagpasimulang mangagkatuwiranan, na nangagsasabi, Sino ito na nagsasalita ng mga kapusungan? Sino ang makapagpapatawad ng mga kasalanan, kundi ang Dios lamang?
en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

tgl: Datapuwa't si Jesus, na nakatatanto ng kanilang mga iniisip, ay sumagot at sinabi sa kanila, Bakit pinagbubulaybulay ninyo sa inyong mga puso?
en: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?

tgl: Alin baga ang lalong magaang sabihin, Ipinatatawad sa iyo ang iyong mga kasalanan; o sabihin, Magtindig ka at lumakad ka?
en: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

tgl: Datapuwa't upang maalaman ninyo na ang Anak ng tao ay may kapamahalaan sa lupa na magpatawad ng mga kasalanan (sinabi niya sa lumpo), Sa iyo ko sinasabi, Magtindig ka, at buhatin mo ang iyong higaan, at umuwi ka sa bahay mo.
en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

tgl: At pagdaka'y nagtindig siya sa harap nila, at binuhat ang kaniyang hinigan, at napasa kaniyang bahay, na niluluwalhati ang Dios.
en: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon  he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

tgl: At nagsipanggilalas ang lahat at niluwalhati nila ang Dios; at nangapuspos sila ng takot, na nangagsasabi, Nakakita kami ngayon ng mga bagay na katakataka.
en: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

tgl: At pagkatapos ng mga bagay na ito, siya'y umalis, at nakita ang isang maniningil ng buwis, na nagngangalang Levi, na nakaupo sa paningilan ng buwis, at sinabi sa kaniya, Sumunod ka sa akin.
en: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.

tgl: At iniwan niya ang lahat at nagtindig at sumunod sa kaniya.
en: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

tgl: At siya'y ipinagpiging ng malaki ni Levi sa kaniyang bahay: at lubhang maraming maniningil ng buwis at mga iba pa na nangakasalo nila sa dulang.
en: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down  with them.

tgl: At nangagbulongbulungan ang mga Fariseo at ang kanilang mga eskriba laban sa kaniyang mga alagad, na nangagsasabi, Bakit kayo'y nagsisikain at nagsisiinom na kasalo ng mga maniningil ng buwis at ng mga makasalanan?
en: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

tgl: At pagsagot ni Jesus ay sinabi sa kanila, Ang mga walang sakit ay hindi nangangailangan ng manggagamot; kundi ang mga may sakit.
en: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need  not a physician; but they that are sick.

tgl: Hindi ako pumarito upang tawagin ang mga matuwid, kundi ang mga makasalanan sa pagsisisi.
en: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

tgl: At sinabi nila sa kaniya, Ang mga alagad ni Juan ay nangagaayunong madalas, at nagsisigawa ng mga pagdaing; gayon din ang mga alagad ng mga Fariseo; datapuwa't ang mga iyo'y nagsisikain at nagsisiinom.
en: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

tgl: At sinabi ni Jesus sa kanila, Mangyayari bagang papagayunuhin ninyo ang mga abay sa kasalan samantalang ang kasintahang lalake ay kasama nila?
en: And he said unto them,  Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while  the bridegroom is with them?

tgl: Datapuwa't darating ang mga araw; at pagka inalis sa kanila ang kasintahang lalake, kung magkagayo'y mangagaayuno sila sa mga araw na yaon.
en: But the days will come, when  the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

tgl: At sinalita rin naman niya sa kanila ang isang talinghaga: Walang taong pumilas sa bagong damit at itinagpi sa damit na luma; sa ibang paraa'y sisirain ang bago, at sa luma naman ay hindi bagay ang tagping mula sa bago.
en: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old ; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

tgl: At walang taong nagsisilid ng alak na bago sa mga balat na luma; sa ibang paraa'y papuputukin ng alak na bago ang mga balat, at mabububo, masisira ang mga balat.
en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and  be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

tgl: Kundi dapat isilid ang alak na bago sa mga bagong balat.
en: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

tgl: At walang taong nakainom ng alak na laon, ay iibig sa alak na bago; sapagka't sasabihin niya, Mabuti ang laon.
en: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

tgl: Nangyari nga nang dumaraan siya sa mga trigohan nang isang sabbath, ay kumitil ng mga uhay ang mga alagad niya, at kinakain pagkaligis sa kanilang mga kamay.
en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

tgl: Datapuwa't sinabi ng ilan sa mga Fariseo, Bakit ginagawa ninyo ang di matuwid gawin sa araw ng sabbath?
en: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

tgl: At pagsagot sa kanila ni Jesus ay sinabi, Hindi baga nabasa ninyo ang ginawa ni David, nang siya'y magutom, siya, at ang mga kasamahan niya;
en: And Jesus answering them  said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;

tgl: Kung paanong siya'y pumasok sa bahay ng Dios, at kumain ng mga tinapay na handog, at binigyan pati ang kaniyang mga kasamahan; na hindi naaayon sa kautusan na kanin ninoman kundi ng mga saserdote lamang?
en: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread , and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kanila, Ang Anak ng tao ay panginoon ng sabbath.
en: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

tgl: At nangyari nang ibang sabbath, na siya'y pumasok sa sinagoga at nagturo: at doo'y may isang lalake, at tuyo ang kaniyang kanang kamay.
en: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose  right hand was withered.

tgl: At inaabangan siya ng mga eskriba at ng mga Fariseo, kung siya'y magpapagaling sa sabbath; upang makasumpong sila ng paraan na siya'y maisakdal.
en: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

tgl: Datapuwa't nalalaman niya ang kanilang mga kaisipan; at sinabi niya sa lalake na tuyo ang kamay, Magtindig ka at tumayo ka sa gitna. At siya'y nagtindig at tumayo.
en: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

tgl: At sinabi sa kanila ni Jesus, Itinatanong ko sa inyo, Matuwid bagang gumawa ng magaling, o gumawa ng masama kung sabbath? magligtas ng isang buhay o pumuksa?
en: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?

tgl: At minamasdan niya silang lahat sa palibotlibot, at sinabi sa kaniya, Iunat mo ang iyong kamay. At ginawa niyang gayon; at gumaling ang kaniyang kamay.
en: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

tgl: Datapuwa't sila'y nangapuno ng galit; at nangagsangusapan, kung ano ang kanilang magagawang laban kay Jesus.
en: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another  what  they might do to Jesus.

tgl: At nangyari nang mga araw na ito, na siya'y napasa bundok upang manalangin; at sa buong magdamag ay nanatili siya sa pananalangin sa Dios.
en: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night  in prayer to God.

tgl: At nang araw na, ay tinawag niya ang kaniyang mga alagad; at siya'y humirang ng labingdalawa sa kanila, na tinawag naman niyang mga apostol:
en: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

tgl: Si Simon, na tinawag naman niyang Pedro, at si Andres na kaniyang kapatid, at si Santiago at si Juan, at si Felipe at si Bartolome.
en: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

tgl: At si Mateo at si Tomas, at si Santiago anak ni Alfeo, at si Simon, na tinatawag na Masikap,
en: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,

tgl: At si Judas na anak ni Santiago, at si Judas Iscariote na naging lilo;
en: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

tgl: At bumaba siya na kasama nila, at tumigil sa isang patag na dako, at ang lubhang marami sa mga alagad niya, at ang lubhang malaking bilang ng mga tao mula sa buong Judea at sa Jerusalem, at sa pangpangin ng dagat ng Tiro at Sidon, na nangagsidalo upang magsipakinig sa kaniya, at upang pagalingin sa kanilang mga sakit;
en: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain , and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

tgl: Ang mga pinahihirapan ng mga espiritung karumaldumal ay pinagagaling.
en: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

tgl: At pinagpipilitan ng buong karamihan na siya'y mahipo; sapagka't lumalabas sa kaniya ang makapangyarihang bisa, at nagpapagaling sa lahat.
en: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

tgl: At itiningin niya ang kaniyang mga mata sa kaniyang mga alagad, at sinabi, Mapapalad kayong mga dukha: sapagka't inyo ang kaharian ng Dios.
en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

tgl: Mapapalad kayong nangagugutom ngayon: sapagka't kayo'y bubusugin. Mapapalad kayong nagsisitangis ngayon: sapagka't kayo'y magsisitawa.
en: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

tgl: Mapapalad kayo kung kayo'y kapootan ng mga tao, at kung kayo'y ihiwalay nila, at kayo'y alimurahin, at itakuwil ang inyong pangalan na tila masasama, dahil sa Anak ng tao.
en: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

tgl: Mangagalak kayo sa araw na yaon, at magsilukso kayo sa kagalakan; sapagka't narito, ang ganti sa inyo'y malaki sa langit; sapagka't sa gayon ding paraan ang ginawa ng kanilang mga magulang sa mga propeta.
en: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

tgl: Datapuwa't sa aba ninyong mayayaman! sapagka't tinanggap na ninyo ang inyong kaaliwan.
en: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

tgl: Sa aba ninyo mga busog ngayon! sapagka't kayo'y mangagugutom. Sa aba ninyong nagsisitawa ngayon! sapagka't kayo'y magsisitaghoy at magsisitangis.
en: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.

tgl: Sa aba ninyo, pagka ang lahat ng mga tao ay mangagsalita ng magaling tungkol sa inyo! sapagka't sa gayon ding paraan ang ginawa ng kanilang mga magulang sa mga bulaang propeta.
en: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so  did their fathers to the false prophets.

tgl: Datapuwa't sinasabi ko sa inyong nangakikinig, Ibigin ninyo ang inyong mga kaaway, gawan ninyo ng mabuti ang nangapopoot sa inyo,
en: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

tgl: Pagpalain ninyo ang sa inyo'y sumusumpa at ipanalangin ninyo ang sa inyo'y lumalait.
en: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

tgl: Sa sumampal sa iyo sa isang pisngi, iharap mo naman ang kabila; at ang sa iyo'y magalis ng iyong balabal, huwag mong itanggi pati ng iyong tunika.
en: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.

tgl: Bigyan mo ang bawa't sa iyo'y humihingi; at sa kumuha ng pag-aari mo, ay huwag mong hinging muli.
en: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

tgl: At kung ano ang ibig ninyong sa inyo'y gawin ng mga tao, gayon din ang gawin ninyo sa kanila.
en: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

tgl: At kung kayo'y magsiibig sa mga nagsisiibig sa inyo, anong pasasalamat ang inyong kakamtin? sapagka't ang mga makasalanan man ay nagsisiibig sa nagsisiibig sa kanila.
en: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

tgl: At kung magsigawa kayo ng mabuti sa nagsisigawa sa inyo ng mabuti, anong pasasalamat ang inyong kakamtin? sapagka't ganito rin ang ginagawa ng mga makasalanan.
en: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

tgl: At kung kayo'y mangagpahiram doon sa mga inaasahan ninyong may tatanggapin, anong pasasalamat ang inyong kakamtin? ang mga makasalanan man ay nangagpapahiram sa mga makasalanan, upang muling magsitanggap ng gayon din.
en: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope  to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

tgl: Datapuwa't ibigin ninyo ang inyong mga kaaway at gawan ninyo sila ng mabuti, at mangagpahiram kayo, na kailan man ay huwag mawawalan ng pagasa; at malaki ang sa inyo'y magiging ganti, at kayo'y magiging mga anak ng Kataastaasan: sapagka't siya'y magandang-loob sa mga walang turing at sa masasama.
en: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

tgl: Magmaawain kayo, gaya naman ng inyong Ama na maawain.
en: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

tgl: At huwag kayong mangagsihatol, at hindi kayo hahatulan: at huwag kayong mangagparusa, at hindi kayo parurusahan: mangagpalaya kayo, at kayo'y palalayain:
en: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

tgl: Mangagbigay kayo, at kayo'y bibigyan; takal na mabuti, pikpik, liglig, at umaapaw, ay ibibigay nila sa inyong kandungan. Sapagka't sa panukat na inyong isukat ay doon kayo muling susukatin.
en: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

tgl: At sinabi naman niya sa kanila ang isang talinghaga: Mangyayari bagang umakay ang bulag sa bulag? di baga sila mangabubulid kapuwa sa hukay?
en: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

tgl: Hindi higit ang alagad sa kaniyang guro: datapuwa't ang bawa't isa, pagka naging sakdal, ay nagiging katulad ng kaniyang guro.
en: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master. <sup>that: or, shall be perfected as his master</sup>

tgl: At bakit mo tinitingnan ang puwing na nasa mata ng iyong kapatid, datapuwa't hindi mo pinupuna ang tahilan na nasa iyong sariling mata?
en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

tgl: O paanong masasabi mo sa iyong kapatid, Kapatid, pabayaan mong alisin ko ang puwing na nasa iyong mata, kundi mo nakikita ang tahilan na nasa iyong sariling mata? Ikaw na mapagpaimbabaw, alisin mo muna ang tahilan na nasa iyong sariling mata, kung magkagayo'y makikita mong malinaw ang pagaalis ng puwing na nasa mata ng iyong kapatid.
en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

tgl: Sapagka't walang mabuting punong kahoy na nagbubunga ng masama; at wala rin naman masamang punong kahoy na nagbubunga ng mabuti.
en: For a good tree bringeth  not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

tgl: Sapagka't bawa't punong kahoy ay nakikilala sa kaniyang sariling bunga. Sapagka't ang mga tao ay di nangakapuputi ng mga igos sa mga dawag, at di nangakapuputi ng ubas sa mga tinikan.
en: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes. <sup>grapes: Gr. a grape</sup>

tgl: Ang mabuting tao ay kumukuha ng kagalingan sa mabubuting kayamanan ng kaniyang puso; at ang masamang tao'y kumukuha ng kasamaan sa masamang kayamanan: sapagka't sa kasaganaan ng puso ay nagsasalita ang kaniyang bibig.
en: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

tgl: At bakit tinatawag ninyo ako, Panginoon, Panginoon, at di ninyo ginagawa ang mga bagay na aking sinasabi?
en: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

tgl: Ang bawa't lumalapit sa akin, at pinakikinggan ang aking mga salita, at ginagawa, ituturo ko sa inyo kung sino ang katulad:
en: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

tgl: Siya'y tulad sa isang taong nagtatayo ng bahay, na humukay at pinakalalim, at inilagay ang patibayan sa bato: at nang dumating ang isang baha, ay hinampas ng agos ang bahay na yaon, at hindi nakilos; sapagka't natitirik na mabuti.
en: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

tgl: Datapuwa't ang dumirinig, at hindi ginagawa, ay tulad sa isang tao na nagtayo ng bahay sa lupa, na walang patibayan; laban sa yaon ay hinampas ng agos, at pagdaka'y nagiba; at malaki ang naging kasiraan ng bahay na yaon.
en: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

tgl: Nang matapos na niya ang lahat ng kaniyang mga pananalita sa mga pakinig ng bayan, ay pumasok siya sa Capernaum.
en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

tgl: At ang alipin ng isang senturion, na minamahal nito, ay may sakit at malapit nang mamatay.
en: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

tgl: At nang marinig niya ang tungkol kay Jesus, ay pinaparoon niya sa kaniya ang matatanda sa mga Judio, na ipamanhik sa kaniya, na pumaroon at iligtas ang kaniyang alipin.
en: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

tgl: At nang magsidating sila kay Jesus, ay ipinamanhik nilang mapilit sa kaniya, na sinasabi, Karapatdapat siya na gawin mo sa kaniya ito;
en: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

tgl: Sapagka't iniibig niya ang ating bansa, at ipinagtayo niya tayo ng ating sinagoga.
en: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

tgl: At si Jesus ay sumama sa kanila. At nang siya'y di na lubhang malayo sa bahay, ay nagsugo sa kaniya ang senturion ng mga kaibigan, na nagsisipagsabi sa kaniya, Panginoon, huwag ka nang maligalig, sapagka't di ako karapatdapat na ikaw ay pumasok sa silong ng aking bubungan:
en: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

tgl: Dahil dito'y hindi ko inakalang ako'y karapatdapat man lamang pumariyan sa iyo: datapuwa't sabihin mo ang salita, at gagaling ang aking alipin.
en: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

tgl: Sapagka't ako rin naman ay taong nasa ilalim ng kapamahalaan, may nasasakupan akong mga kawal: at sinasabi ko rito, Yumaon ka, at siya'y yumayaon; at sa isa, Halika, at siya'y lumalapit; at sa aking alipin, Gawin mo ito, at kaniyang ginagawa.
en: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it. <sup>one: Gr. this man</sup>

tgl: At nang marinig ni Jesus ang mga bagay na ito, ay nagtaka siya sa kaniya, at lumingon at sinabi sa karamihang nagsisisunod sa kaniya, Sinasabi ko sa inyo, Hindi ako nakasumpong ng ganitong kalaking pananampalataya, hindi, kahit sa Israel man.
en: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

tgl: At pagbalik sa bahay ng mga sinugo, ay kanilang naratnang magaling na ang alipin.
en: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

tgl: At nangyari pagkatapos ng kaunting panahon, na siya'y naparoon sa bayan na tinatawag na Nain; at kasama niya ang kaniyang mga alagad, at ang lubhang maraming tao.
en: And it came to pass  the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

tgl: At nang siya nga'y malapit na sa pintuan ng bayan, narito, inilalabas ang isang patay, bugtong na anak na lalake ng kaniyang ina, at siya'y bao: at kasama niya ang maraming tao na taga bayan.
en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold , there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

tgl: At pagkakita sa kaniya ng Panginoon, siya'y kinahabagan niya, at sinabi sa kaniya, Huwag kang tumangis.
en: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

tgl: At siya'y lumapit at hinipo ang kabaong: at ang nangagdadala ay tumigil. At sinabi niya, Binata, sinasabi ko sa iyo, Magbangon ka.
en: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise. <sup>bier: or, coffin</sup>

tgl: At naupo ang patay, at nagpasimulang magsalita. At siya'y ibinigay niya sa kaniyang ina.
en: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

tgl: At sinidlan ng takot ang lahat: at niluluwalhati nila ang Dios, na sinasabi, Lumitaw sa gitna natin ang isang dakilang propeta: at, dinalaw ng Dios ang kaniyang bayan.
en: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

tgl: At kumalat ang balitang ito tungkol sa kaniya sa buong Judea, at sa buong palibotlibot ng lupain.
en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.

tgl: At ibinalita kay Juan ng kaniyang mga alagad ang lahat ng mga bagay na ito.
en: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.

tgl: At sa pagpapalapit ni Juan sa kaniya ng dalawa sa kaniyang mga alagad, ay sinugo sila sa Panginoon, na nagpapasabi, Ikaw baga yaong paririto, o hihintayin namin ang iba?
en: And John calling unto him two  of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

tgl: At pagdating sa kaniya ng mga tao, ay kanilang sinabi, Pinaparito kami sa iyo ni Juan Bautista, na ipinasasabi, Ikaw baga yaong paririto, o hihintayin namin ang iba?
en: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

tgl: Nang oras na yaon ay nagpagaling siya ng maraming may sakit at mga pagkasalot at masasamang espiritu; at kaniyang pinagkaloobang mangakakita ang maraming bulag.
en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.

tgl: At sumagot siya at sa kanila'y sinabi, Magsiparoon kayo, at sabihin ninyo kay Juan ang mga bagay na inyong nangakita at nangarinig; ang mga bulag ay nangakakakita, ang mga pilay ay nagsisilakad, ang mga ketongin ay nangalilinis, at ang mga bingi ay nangakaririnig, ang mga patay ay ibinabangon, sa mga dukha ay ipinangangaral ang mabubuting balita.
en: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

tgl: At mapalad ang sinomang hindi makasumpong ng anomang katitisuran sa akin.
en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

tgl: At nang mangakaalis na ang mga sugo ni Juan, ay nagpasimula siyang magsalita tungkol kay Juan sa mga karamihan, Ano ang linabas ninyo upang mamasdan sa ilang? isang tambong inuuga ng hangin?
en: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

tgl: Datapuwa't ano ang linabas ninyo upang makita? isang taong nararamtan ng mga damit na maseselang? Narito, ang nagsisipanamit ng maririlag, at nangabubuhay sa pagmamaselang ay nasa mga palasio ng mga hari.
en: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

tgl: Datapuwa't ano ang linabas ninyo upang makita? isa bagang propeta? Oo, sinasabi ko sa inyo, at higit pa sa isang propeta.
en: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.

tgl: Ito yaong tungkol sa kaniya'y nasusulat, Narito, sinusugo ko ang aking sugo sa unahan ng iyong mukha, Na maghahanda ng iyong daan sa unahan mo.
en: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

tgl: Sinasabi ko sa inyo, Sa mga ipinanganak ng mga babae ay walang dakila kay sa kay Juan: gayon ma'y ang lalong maliit sa kaharian ng Dios ay lalong dakila kay sa kaniya.
en: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

tgl: At pagkarinig ng buong bayan, at ng mga maniningil ng buwis ay pinatotohanan ang Dios, na nagsipagbautismo ng bautismo ni Juan.
en: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

tgl: Datapuwa't pinawalang halaga ng mga Fariseo at ng mga tagapagtanggol ng kautusan sa kanilang sarili ang payo ng Dios, at hindi napabautismo sa kaniya.
en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him. <sup>rejected: or, frustrated</sup> <sup>against: or, within themselves</sup>

tgl: Sa ano ko itutulad ang mga tao ng lahing ito, at ano ang kanilang katulad?
en: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

tgl: Tulad sila sa mga batang nangakaupo sa pamilihan, at nagsisigawan sa isa't isa; na sinasabi, Tinutugtugan namin kayo ng plauta, at hindi kayo nagsisayaw; nanambitan kami at hindi kayo nagsitangis.
en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

tgl: Sapagka't naparito si Juan Bautista na hindi kumakain ng tinapay at hindi umiinom ng alak at inyong sinasabi, Siya'y may isang demonio.
en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

tgl: Naparito ang Anak ng tao na kumakain at umiinom; at inyong sinasabi, Narito ang isang matakaw na tao, at isang magiinum ng alak, isang kaibigan ng mga maniningil ng buwis at ng mga makasalanan!
en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

tgl: At ang karunungan ay pinatotohanan ng lahat ng kaniyang mga anak.
en: But wisdom is justified of all her children.

tgl: At ipinamanhik sa kaniya ng isa sa mga Fariseo na kumaing kasalo niya. At siya'y pumasok sa bahay ng Fariseo at naupo sa dulang.
en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

tgl: At narito, ang isang babaing makasalanan na nasa bayan; at nang maalaman niyang siya'y nasa dulang ng pagkain sa bahay ng Fariseo ay nagdala siya ng isang sisidlang alabastro na puno ng unguento,
en: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

tgl: At nakatayo sa likuran sa kaniyang mga paanan na tumatangis, ay pinasimulan niyang dinilig ng mga luha ang kaniyang mga paa, at ang mga ito'y kinukuskos ng buhok ng kaniyang ulo, at hinahagkan ang kaniyang mga paa, at pinapahiran ng unguento.
en: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

tgl: Nang makita nga ito ng Fariseo na sa kaniya'y naganyaya, ay nagsalita sa kaniyang sarili, na sinasabi, Ang taong ito, kung siya'y isang propeta ay nakikilala niya kung sino at kung ano ang babaing ito na sa kaniya'y humihipo, na siya'y makasalanan.
en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

tgl: At pagsagot ni Jesus ay sinabi sa kaniya, Simon, ako'y may isang bagay na sasabihin sa iyo. At sinabi niya, Guro, sabihin mo.
en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.

tgl: Isang may pautang ay may dalawang may utang sa kaniya: at ang isa'y may utang na limang daang denario, at ang isa'y limangpu.
en: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

tgl: Nang sila'y walang maibayad, ay kapuwa pinatawad niya. Alin nga sa kanila ang lalong iibig sa kaniya?
en: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

tgl: Sumagot si Simon at sinabi, Inaakala ko na yaong pinatawad niya ng lalong malaki. At sinabi niya sa kaniya, Matuwid ang pagkahatol mo.
en: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

tgl: At paglingon sa babae, ay sinabi niya kay Simon, Nakikita mo baga ang babaing ito? Pumasok ako sa iyong bahay, hindi mo ako binigyan ng tubig na ukol sa aking mga paa: datapuwa't dinilig niya ang aking mga ng kaniyang mga luha, at kinuskos ng kaniyang buhok.
en: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she  hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

tgl: Hindi mo ako binigyan ng halik: datapuwa't siya, buhat nang ako'y pumasok ay hindi humihinto ng paghalik sa aking mga paa.
en: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman  since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

tgl: Hindi mo pinahiran ng langis ang aking ulo: datapuwa't pinahiran niya ng unguento ang aking mga paa.
en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman  hath anointed my feet with ointment.

tgl: Kaya nga sinasabi ko sa inyo, Ipinatatawad ang kaniyang maraming kasalanan; sapagka't siya ay umibig ng malaki: datapuwa't sa pinatatawad ng kaunti, ay kakaunti ang pagibig.
en: Wherefore  I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.

tgl: At sinabi niya sa babae, Ipinatatawad ang iyong mga kasalanan.
en: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.

tgl: At ang mga kasalo niyang nangakaupo sa dulang ng pagkain ay nagpasimulang nangagsabi sa kanilang sarili, Sino ito, na nagpapatawad pati ng mga kasalanan?
en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

tgl: At sinabi niya sa babae, Iniligtas ka ng iyong pananampalataya; yumaon kang payapa.
en: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

tgl: At nangyari pagkatapos ng kaunting panahon, na siya'y naglalakad sa mga bayan at mga nayon, na ipinangangaral at dinadala ang mabubuting balita ng kaharian ng Dios, at kasama niya ang labingdalawa,
en: And it came to pass afterward , that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,

tgl: At ang ilang babae na pinagaling sa masasamang espiritu at sa mga sakit, si Maria, na tinatawag na Magdalena, na sa kaniya'y pitong demonio ang nagsilabas,
en: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

tgl: At si Juana na asawa ni Chuza, katiwala ni Herodes, at si Susana, at iba pang marami na ipinaglilingkod sa kanila ang kanilang tinatangkilik.
en: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

tgl: At nang magkatipon ang malaking karamihang tao, at ang mga mula sa bawa't bayan na nagsadya sa kaniya, ay nagsalita siya sa pamamagitan ng isang talinghaga:
en: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:

tgl: Ang manghahasik ay yumaon upang maghasik ng kaniyang binhi: at sa kaniyang paghahasik ang ilan ay nangahulog sa tabi ng daan; at napagyapakan, at ito'y kinain ng mga ibon sa langit.
en: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some  fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

tgl: At ang iba'y nahulog sa batuhan; at pagsibol, ay natuyo, sapagka't walang halumigmig.
en: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked  moisture.

tgl: At ang iba'y nahulog sa mga dawagan; at tumubong kasama ang mga dawag, at yao'y ininis.
en: And some fell among  thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked  it.

tgl: At ang iba'y nahulog sa mabuting lupa, at tumubo at nagbunga ng tigiisang daan. Pagkasabi niya ng mga bagay na ito, siya ay sumigaw, Ang may mga pakinig na ipakikinig, ay makinig.
en: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

tgl: At tinanong siya ng kaniyang mga alagad, kung ano kaya ang talinghagang ito.
en: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

tgl: At sinabi niya, Sa inyo'y ipinagkaloob ang mangakaalam ng mga hiwaga ng kaharian ng Dios: datapuwa't sa mga iba'y sa mga talinghaga; upang kung magsitingin ay huwag silang mangakakita, at mangakarinig ay huwag silang mangakaunawa.
en: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

tgl: Ito ang talinghaga: Ang binhi ay ang salita ng Dios.
en: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

tgl: At ang mga sa tabi ng daan, ay ang nangakinig; kung magkagayo'y dumarating ang diablo, at inaalis ang salita sa kanilang puso, upang huwag silang magsisampalataya at mangaligtas.
en: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

tgl: At ang mga sa batuhan, ay yaong mga pagkarinig, ay tinatanggap na may galak ang salita; at ang mga ito'y walang ugat, na sila sa sangdaling panaho'y nagsisisampalataya, at sa panahon ng tukso ay nagsisihiwalay.
en: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

tgl: At ang nahulog sa dawagan, ay ito ang nangakinig, at samantalang sila'y nagsisiyaon sa kanilang lakad ay iniinis sila ng mga pagsusumakit at mga kayamanan at mga kalayawan sa buhay na ito, at hindi nangagbubunga ng kasakdalan.
en: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

tgl: At ang sa mabuting lupa ay ang mga pusong timtiman at mabuti, na iniingatan ang salita pagkarinig, at nangagbubunga may pagtitiis.
en: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.

tgl: At walang taong pagkapaningas niya ng ilawan ay tinatakpan ng isang banga, o inilalagay kaya ito sa ilalim ng isang higaan; kundi inilalagay ito sa talagang lalagyan, upang makita ng nagsisipasok ang ilaw.
en: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

tgl: Sapagka't walang bagay na natatago, na di mahahayag; o walang lihim, na di makikilala at mapapasa liwanag.
en: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad .

tgl: Ingatan ninyo kung paano ang inyong pakikinig: sapagka't sino mang mayroon ay bibigyan; at ang sinomang wala, pati ng inaakala niyang nasa kaniya ay aalisin.
en: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever  hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever  hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have. <sup>seemeth: or, thinketh that he hath</sup>

tgl: At nagsiparoon sa kaniya ang kaniyang ina at mga kapatid, at sila'y hindi mangakalapit sa kaniya dahil sa karamihan ng tao.
en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

tgl: At may nagsabi sa kaniya, Nangakatayo sa labas ang iyong ina at iyong mga kapatid, na ibig nilang makita ka.
en: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.

tgl: Datapuwa't siya'y sumagot, at sinabi sa kanila, Ang aking ina at ang aking mga kapatid ay itong nangakikinig ng salita ng Dios, at ginagawa.
en: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.

tgl: Nangyari nga sa mga araw na yaon, na siya'y lumulan sa isang daong, siya at ang kaniyang mga alagad; at sinabi niya sa kanila, Magsitawid tayo sa kabilang ibayo ng dagatdagatan: at sila'y nagsitulak.
en: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.

tgl: Datapuwa't samantalang sila'y nangaglalayag, siya'y nakatulog: at bumugso ang isang unos ng hangin sa dagatdagatan; at sila'y nangatitigib ng tubig, at nangasa kapanganiban.
en: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

tgl: At sila'y nangagsilapit sa kaniya at siya'y ginising, na nangagsasabi, Guro, guro, tayo'y mangamamatay. At siya'y gumising, at sinaway ang hangin at ang galit ng tubig: at nangagsitigil, at humusay ang panahon.
en: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

tgl: At sinabi niya sa kanila, Saan naroon ang inyong pananampalataya? At palibhasa'y nangatakot sila'y nagsisipanggilalas, na sinasabi ng isa sa iba, Sino nga ito, na siya'y naguutos maging sa hangin at sa tubig, at siya'y tinatalima nila?
en: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another , What manner of man  is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.

tgl: At sila'y nagsidating sa lupain ng mga Gadareno, na nasa tapat ng Galilea.
en: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.

tgl: At pagkalunsad niya sa lupa, siya'y sinalubong ng isang lalaking galing sa bayan, na may mga demonio; at malaong panahon na hindi siya nagdaramit, at hindi tumatahan sa bahay, kundi sa mga libingan.
en: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long  time, and ware no clothes, neither  abode in any house, but in the tombs.

tgl: At nang makita niya si Jesus, siya'y sumigaw, at nagpatirapa sa harap niya, at sinabi ng malakas na tinig, Ano ang pakialam ko sa iyo, Jesus, ikaw na Anak ng Dios na Kataastaasan? Ipinamamanhik ko sa iyo, na huwag mo akong pahirapan.
en: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.

tgl: Sapagka't ipinagutos niya sa karumaldumal na espiritu na lumabas sa tao. Sapagka't madalas siyang inaalihan: at siya'y binabantayan at gapos ng mga tanikala at mga damal; at pagka pinapatid ang gapos ay siya'y itinataboy ng demonio sa mga ilang.
en: (For he had commanded  the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes  it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

tgl: At tinanong siya ni Jesus, Ano ang pangalan mo? At sinabi niya, Pulutong; sapagka't maraming demonio ang nagsipasok sa kaniya.
en: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

tgl: At ipinamamanhik nila sa kaniya na huwag silang paparoonin sa kalalimlaliman.
en: And they besought  him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.

tgl: Doon nga'y may isang kawan ng maraming baboy na nagsisipanginain sa bundok: at ipinamanhik nila sa kaniya na pabayaang sila'y magsipasok sa mga yaon. At sila'y pinahintulutan niya.
en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.

tgl: At nagsilabas ang mga demonio sa tao, at nagsipasok sa mga baboy: at ang kawan ay napadaluhong sa bangin hanggang sa dagatdagatan, at nangalunod.
en: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

tgl: At nang makita ng nagsisipagalaga ng mga yaon ang nangyari, ay nagsitakas, at isinaysay sa bayan at sa bukid.
en: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

tgl: At sila'y nagsilabas upang makita ang nangyari; at nagsilapit sila kay Jesus, at kanilang naratnan sa paanan ni Jesus ang taong nilabasan ng mga demonio, na nakaupo, may pananamit, at matino ang kaniyang bait: at sila'y nangatakot.
en: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

tgl: At sa kanila'y isinaysay ng nangakakita kung paanong pinagaling ang inaalihan ng mga demonio.
en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.

tgl: At ipinamanhik sa kaniya ng lahat ng mga tao sa palibotlibot ng lupain ng mga Gadareno na siya'y umalis sa kanila, sapagka't sila'y napipigilan ng malaking takot: at siya'y lumulan sa daong, at nagbalik.
en: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.

tgl: Datapuwa't namanhik sa kaniya ang taong nilabasan ng mga demonio, na siya'y ipagsama niya: datapuwa't siya'y pinaalis niya, na sinasabi,
en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,

tgl: Umuwi ka sa iyong bahay, at ipahayag mo kung gaano kadakilang mga bagay ang ginawa ng Dios sa iyo. At siya'y yumaon ng kaniyang lakad, na ibinabalita sa buong bayan, kung gaanong kadakilang mga bagay ang sa kaniya'y ginawa ni Jesus.
en: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.

tgl: At sa pagbalik ni Jesus, ay sinalubong siyang may galak ng karamihan; sapagka't hinihintay siya nilang lahat.
en: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

tgl: At narito, lumapit ang isang lalaking nagngangalang Jairo, at siya'y isang pinuno sa sinagoga: at siya'y nagpatirapa sa paanan ni Jesus, at ipinamamanhik sa kaniya, na pumasok sa kaniyang bahay;
en: And, behold, there came a man named  Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

tgl: Sapagka't siya'y may isang bugtong na anak na babae, na may labingdalawang taong gulang, at siya'y naghihingalo. Datapuwa't samantalang siya'y lumalakad ay sinisiksik siya ng karamihan.
en: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she  lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

tgl: At isang babae na may labingdalawang taon nang inaagasan, na ginugol sa mga manggagamot ang lahat niyang pagkabuhay, at sinoma'y walang makapagpagaling sa kaniya,
en: And a woman having  an issue of blood twelve years , which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

tgl: Ay lumapit sa kaniyang likuran, at hinipo ang laylayan ng kaniyang damit at pagdaka'y naampat ang kaniyang agas.
en: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.

tgl: At sinabi ni Jesus, Sino ang humipo sa akin? At nang tumatanggi ang lahat, ay sinabi ni Pedro, at ng mga kasamahan niya, Guro, iniimpit ka at sinisiksik ka ng karamihan.
